title: 第一卷·第一章

segments.original: riverrun, past Eve and Adam's, from swerve of shore to bend of bay, brings us by a commodius vicus of recirculation back to Howth Castle and Environs.
segments.draft: 河流，经过夏娃与亚当，从曲岸到弯湾，循宽舒回环小径，又把人带回霍斯城堡及周围。
segments.translation: 河水流，过夏娃与亚当，自岸曲而湾弯，循宽舒回环小径，又领人回到霍斯堡及四邻。

notes.lemma: riverrun
notes.text: river 与 run 连写，兼有河流与奔流之势。试译拆成“河水流”，让名词转入动作；尚未保住原词紧缩感。

notes.lemma: Eve and Adam's
notes.text: FinnegansWiki 将此语联系到都柏林 Adam and Eve’s 教堂。Joyce 倒置人名，仍让读者听见《创世记》。正文保留倒序，暂不补出“教堂”。教堂沿革仍待查原始资料。

notes.lemma: swerve of shore / bend of bay
notes.text: shore 与 swerve、bay 与 bend 两两呼应。试译用“岸曲／湾弯”补偿音响；“湾弯”刻意叠音，并非地名。

notes.lemma: commodius
notes.text: 底本文字是 commodius，勿按常见英语 commodious 自动更正。FinnegansWiki 汇集其拉丁词形及英语“宽舒”联想；此处暂取宽舒，未穷尽其他读法。

notes.lemma: vicus
notes.text: FinnegansWiki 将 vicus 的巷道、村落义与 Giambattista Vico（维柯）之名并读。结合 recirculation，可联想到历史回环。正文先取“小径”，维柯留在注内，避免把解释直接写成原文。

notes.lemma: recirculation
notes.text: 末页停在 the，开篇从小写 riverrun 接起，首尾可连读。JJDA 导读指出这层回环；它与河流入海、再返的意象相应。

notes.lemma: Howth Castle and Environs
notes.text: 三项首字母拼出 HCE。译文地名暂作“霍斯堡及四邻”；中文无法同时保住这组三字母，故在注中记明。FinnegansWiki 亦列此关联。

notes.lemma: brings us … back
notes.text: 原句让河流领读者返回。译作“领人回到”，保留牵引动作；不补一个独立叙述者，也不将首段改成风景简介。

alternatives.text: 河流流，过夏娃与亚当，曲岸弯湾兜转，又回霍斯城堡四周。
alternatives.reason: 更重口语和叠音；漏去宽舒、小径两层，暂不采用。

segments.original: Sir Tristram, violer d'amores, fr'over the short sea, had passencore rearrived from North Armorica on this side the scraggy isthmus of Europe Minor to wielderfight his penisolate war: nor had topsawyer's rocks by the stream Oconee exaggerated themselse to Laurens County's gorgios while they went doublin their mumper all the time: nor avoice from afire bellowsed mishe mishe to tauftauf thuartpeatrick: not yet, though venissoon after, had a kidscad buttended a bland old isaac: not yet, though all's fair in vanessy, were sosie sesthers wroth with twone nathandjoe. Rot a peck of pa's malt had Jhem or Shen brewed by arclight and rory end to the regginbrow was to be seen ringsome on the aquaface.
segments.draft: 特里斯坦爵士，拉情弦又犯情禁，尚未越过短海，从北阿摩里卡重返小欧罗巴嶙峋地峡这一边，重打他那孤茎半岛战：奥科尼溪边，上锯手那堆石头也还未向劳伦斯县戈吉奥乡人夸张堆起自身，一边让乞数不断翻番：也未有声音从火里鼓吼“吾是，吾是”，来洗洗“汝乃彼石帕特里克”：还没有，虽说鹿肉很快便到，羊崽小无赖还未顶退温和老以撒：还没有，虽说凡妮莎里百无禁忌，两位影样以斯帖姊妹还未恼起二合一纳坦乔。老爹一配克麦芽，杰姆或申还没借弧光酿得烂熟；水脸上，雨虹眉那红露一端四围可见。
segments.translation: 特里斯坦爵士，乱拨情弦者，还未越短海，从北阿摩里卡再返小欧罗巴嶙峋地峡这一边，重打那孤茎半岛仗：奥科尼溪边，上锯手那堆石头，也未向劳伦斯县戈吉奥乡人夸堆自身，一边把乞数翻番不休：也未有哪声从哪团火里风箱般吼出“吾是，吾是”，来洗洗“汝乃彼石帕特里克”：羊崽小无赖也还没——虽说鹿肉快来——顶退那温和老以撒：影样以斯帖姊妹也还没——虽说凡妮莎里百无禁忌——恼起那二合一纳坦乔。老爹那一配克麦芽，杰姆或申还没借弧光酿得烂熟；水脸四围，环环可见雨虹眉那一端红露。

notes.lemma: Sir Tristram / North Armorica
notes.text: 1926 年信稿转录将此名兼指 Amory Tristram 与特里斯坦传说，并把北阿摩里卡连到布列塔尼。此处只登记作者自释线索；爵号、征服史与地理未另查原始记录，不据此写成确定史实。

notes.lemma: violer d'amores
notes.text: 社区词目并读爱情弦琴、拉琴者与法语侵犯之意。“乱拨情弦”兼取奏乐、越禁，仍削弱暴力含义；不把这个混合词只译成情郎。

notes.lemma: had passencore rearrived
notes.text: 1926 年信稿转录以法语“尚未”与维柯式回返解释 passencore。“还未……再返”保住否定和重来；后文 nor、not yet 接续否定，不能顺成爵士已经回来。信稿针对早期稿，不能代替现行底本文字。

notes.lemma: wielderfight
notes.text: 信稿转录将此词释作德语“再战”。正文取“重打”；wield 那股挥动武器的劲道未另造字补入，留在此注。

notes.lemma: penisolate war
notes.text: 社区词目列半岛战争、孤立阴茎与孤笔等读路。试造“孤茎半岛仗”，并存地形、性与孤立；笔战一层仍漏失。词内有 penis、isolate 等形影，不等于每项典故均已坐实。

notes.lemma: topsawyer's rocks / exaggerated themselse
notes.text: 社区词目将上锯手、Sawyer 人名与 rocks 的石块、睾丸义并置。信稿另提奥科尼河边那座美国 Dublin，且以拉丁语堆高解释夸张。“夸堆”补这两层；地方建城史与岩石传说尚未独立核实。

notes.lemma: Laurens County's gorgios
notes.text: 社区词目将 gorgio 释作非罗姆人，另听见佐治亚州居民 Georgians。不能反译成吉卜赛人。正文暂音译“戈吉奥”，不抹去词形；词源仍待可靠罗姆语词典复核。

notes.lemma: doublin their mumper
notes.text: doublin 让翻倍与 Dublin 同声；社区词目把 mumper 并读乞人和 number。“乞数”是本项目补偿词，不是现成汉语；保住乞人与数目相撞，却失去都柏林地名回声。原句代词指谁仍留余地。

notes.lemma: avoice from afire / mishe mishe / tauftauf
notes.text: 信稿转录把 Mishe 释作爱尔兰语“吾是”，Tauf 释作德语施洗，并联圣帕特里克点火。“吾是，吾是／洗洗”保留复沓；“风箱般吼”补 bellows 与声音互撞，不另补圣经燃荆场景。

notes.lemma: thuartpeatrick
notes.text: 信稿转录联到彼得与磐石；《马太福音》16:18 可核对应句。“汝乃彼石帕特里克”为本项目嵌译，保住彼得／石头／帕特里克，却未补 peat 的泥炭形影。

notes.lemma: venissoon / kidscad
notes.text: venissoon 可拆听鹿肉与“很快”；kidscad 让羊崽撞上小无赖。《创世记》27:9、16 记山羊羔与羊皮，27:19 记雅各献肉冒名。“鹿肉快来／羊崽小无赖”是本项目拆译，不把它改成经文叙述。

notes.lemma: buttended a bland old isaac
notes.text: 信稿转录兼指帕内尔顶替 Isaac Butt 与雅各取得以撒祝福；《创世记》27:1、35–36 可核失明、欺瞒与顶替。“顶退／老以撒”保动作，Butt 姓氏和 bland／blind 的声差仍留在英文，未把政治史细节写入正文。

notes.lemma: sosie sesthers / vanessy
notes.text: 信稿转录提两位同名 Esther：Vanhomrigh 与 Johnson，并释 sosie 为重影；社区词目连到斯威夫特。“影样以斯帖姊妹”保同名与 sisters 声影，不声称二人有血缘；凡妮莎先保留人名，不把整句只解作爱欲或虚荣。

notes.lemma: twone nathandjoe
notes.text: 社区词目把 two 与 one 叠读，并将 Jonathan 拆换为 Nathan 与 Joe。“二合一纳坦乔”保二／一相争及名字换序；原字中 hand 等旁路未展开，不能据此断言人物已经分成固定两人。

notes.lemma: Rot a peck of pa's malt
notes.text: 社区词目以 Not 的变声解释 Rot，延续否定，又保留腐烂。信稿转录联到彭斯酿麦歌与挪亚醉酒。正文“还没……酿得烂熟”试兼两路，语气仍有损；配克保留原容积单位，不擅折成中国斗升。

notes.lemma: Jhem or Shen
notes.text: 社区词目听出 Jameson 酒名，并联 Shem、Shaun 与挪亚诸子。《创世记》9:18 可核闪、含、雅弗；不能直接把两处变体当成经文原名。正文暂音译杰姆、申，身份待上下文复核。

notes.lemma: brewed by arclight
notes.text: 正文先取弧光。社区词目另联虹弧与方舟之光；《创世记》9:13–16 记虹作约证，9:20–21 记挪亚种葡萄、醉酒。本项目据此保留酿酒与虹光相接，但未把 arclight 固定成方舟灯。

notes.lemma: rory / regginbrow / ringsome / aquaface
notes.text: 信稿转录以红与露释 rory，以德语虹词混英语虹词释 regginbrow，以“四围”释 ringsome。“一端红露／雨虹眉／环环四围／水脸”兼留颜色、露水和身体形影；末一分句未另添否定。

notes.lemma: nor / not yet / rory … regginbrow … ringsome
notes.text: 反复否定把人物、地点与时代压成一串尚未发生；末尾 r 声连转。中文沿用冒号与“也还没”，再以“红露／虹眉／环环”补回声。此为节奏补偿，不宣称复现原音，也不把各典故排成单线史。

alternatives.text: 特里斯坦爵士，犯爱拉琴，还没从北阿摩里卡越海再来，重开半岛孤茎之战。
alternatives.reason: 短句较易入口，却拆掉连锁否定，且把 violer 的声义压成两项；只存作局部备选。

segments.original: The fall (bababadalgharaghtakamminarronnkonnbronntonner-ronntuonnthunntrovarrhounawnskawntoohoohoordenenthur-nuk!) of a once wallstrait oldparr is retaled early in bed and later on life down through all christian minstrelsy. The great fall of the offwall entailed at such short notice the pftjschute of Finnegan, erse solid man, that the humptyhillhead of humself prumptly sends an unquiring one well to the west in quest of his tumptytumtoes: and their upturnpikepointandplace is at the knock out in the park where oranges have been laid to rust upon the green since devlinsfirst loved livvy.
segments.draft: 那曾经墙般挺直的老帕尔摔下（bababadalgharaghtakamminarronnkonnbronntonnerronntuonnthunntrovarrhounawnskawntoohoohoordenenthurnuk！），早在床上传，晚在人生里唱，沿基督徒歌谣一路重说。离墙一记大跌，猝不及防，连带爱尔兰硬实汉芬尼根噗叱坠下，竟让他自家那驼墩山头立刻派出一位不问客，远向西边寻找他那笃墩脚趾：那翘起路栅尖尖处，就在公园里那击倒丘；自从德夫林初恋丽薇，橙子便躺在绿地，锈眠至今。
segments.translation: 老帕爹，当年墙般挺直。他这一跌（bababadalgharaghtakamminarronnkonnbronntonnerronntuonnthunntrovarrhounawnskawntoohoohoordenenthurnuk！），早早在床上讲，晚晚在人生里传，沿基督徒歌谣一路重贩。离墙这记大跌，猝不及防，牵出爱尔兰硬实汉芬尼根那声噗叱坠，竟让他自家那驼墩山头急急遣出一位不问客，远远向西，去寻他那笃墩脚趾：那翘起路栅尖尖处，就在公园里那击倒丘；自从德夫林初恋丽薇，橙子就横躺绿地，锈眠至今。

notes.lemma: The fall
notes.text: 社区词目并列酒歌中芬尼根跌落、人类失乐与 Humpty Dumpty 墙头坠落。已查社区所录酒歌，确写梯上摔下、守灵和酒洒后复起；该转录未注明谱本。本段只取“跌”，不先把肉身、道德与历史压成同一种坠落。

notes.lemma: The fall 后括号内雷鸣词
notes.text: 底本把雷鸣词分排三行，两处加行末连字符；这里合写后共一百个拉丁字母，中文段内保留原拼，不以“轰隆”替换。社区按多语雷声尝试拆分；本项目尚未逐语核对词源，也未宣称中文已复现全部声音。

notes.lemma: wallstrait oldparr
notes.text: 社区词目并读墙般挺直、Wall Street 与 Old Parr、法语父亲声影及股票面值。“老帕爹”试留人名与父亲，“墙般挺直”留站立姿态；股市、酒名与传说年龄未纳入正文。上述历史牵连仍待原始资料核实。

notes.lemma: retaled / entailed
notes.text: 社区词目把 retaled 连到重讲故事与零售；下文 entailed 又让 tale／tail 余音接续。“重贩”试把传说当货转卖，仍失去英语尾音与裁衣旁路，不把 retaled 自动改成 retold。

notes.lemma: early in bed / later on life / christian minstrelsy
notes.text: early、later 同时牵动时刻与人生阶段；bed、life 又把卧床与世间相接。“早早／晚晚”保对称，仍较容易读成先后事件。minstrelsy 先译歌谣；本段未说特定赞美诗，不擅补曲名。

notes.lemma: pftjschute
notes.text: 社区词目以坠落拟声和法语 chute 等解释此词。“噗叱坠”为本项目暂造声词，补喷气、摩擦与下坠，不冒充原词音译；其余食物、审判等联想尚未核实，不强装进中文。

notes.lemma: erse solid man
notes.text: 社区词目并读爱尔兰／盖尔语名 Erse、臀部声影、泥土与坚实。“爱尔兰硬实汉”先取地域与质感，臀部、污泥及歌名等读路留待复核。不可将 erase、earth 等近形近音一概当作确定词源。

notes.lemma: humptyhillhead of humself / tumptytumtoes
notes.text: 社区将 humpty 联到 Humpty Dumpty，并把头、脚读成霍斯与凤凰公园地景。“驼墩山头／笃墩脚趾”补共同节拍，人物与土地仍叠在句内；童谣圆滚形象和英语人名损失较大。具体地图对应尚未核实。

notes.lemma: prumptly sends an unquiring one
notes.text: prumptly 在 promptly 中塞入 rump 声影；unquiring 又让探询词撞上否定前缀。本项目暂作“急急／不问客”，保行动与不问相扯，未保臀部回声；不将不问客改成明确侦探或特定人物。

notes.lemma: well to the west in quest
notes.text: well、west、quest 连续回响，方向也随头脚展开。中文用“远远向西，去寻”补短促推进，未复现辅音；不能凭这一句判断全章旅程，更不把“西”擅解成死亡终点。

notes.lemma: upturnpikepointandplace
notes.text: 社区词目从收费路栅、矛尖与五段词形拆读此缀词。“翘起路栅尖尖处”留下上翘、道路、尖端和地点，牺牲连成一词的紧缩感；路栅史与五趾对应未另核，不据此替正文画定路线。

notes.lemma: the knock out in the park
notes.text: 社区并列 knock 的山丘声义、击倒和凤凰公园附近地名。“击倒丘”是本项目补偿，不是登记地名；公园究指何处、哪两处丘陵，仍待地图与地名资料核对。

notes.lemma: oranges … rust upon the green
notes.text: 社区以橙色、绿色联读爱尔兰政治阵营，并以荷兰语“休息”释 rust。“锈眠”兼补生锈与安息，橙子仍留物象；这些象征不等于原句指认一场具体战役，相关语词仍待词典和史料复核。

notes.lemma: since devlinsfirst loved livvy
notes.text: 社区把 devlinsfirst、livvy 联到 Dublin、魔鬼、利菲河与丽薇人形。正文暂音译“德夫林／丽薇”，让爱恋仍可发生在人名之间；城市与河流回声未尽保留。底本连写 devlinsfirst，照录，不借新版意见拆字或补叙事关系。

alternatives.text: 那曾经挺直如墙的老帕尔一坠，早在床上讲，晚在人生里传，基督徒歌谣一路重讲。
alternatives.reason: 保留字面父名较稳，却淡去 père 声影及 retaled 的贩卖意味；只存作局部备选，雷鸣词仍须另行保留。

segments.original: What clashes here of wills gen wonts, oystrygods gaggin fishygods! Brékkek Kékkek Kékkek Kékkek! Kóax Kóax Kóax! Ualu Ualu Ualu! Quaouauh! Where the Baddelaries partisans are still out to mathmaster Malachus Micgranes and the Verdons catapelting the camibalistics out of the Whoyteboyce of Hoodie Head. Assiegates and boomeringstroms. Sod's brood, be me fear! Sanglorians, save! Arms apeal with larms, appalling. Killykillkilly: a toll, a toll. What chance cuddleys, what cashels aired and ventilated! What bidimetoloves sinduced by what tegotetabsolvers! What true feeling for their's hayair with what strawng voice of false jiccup! O here here how hoth sprowled met the duskt the father of fornicationists but, (O my shining stars and body!) how hath fanespanned most high heaven the skysign of soft advertisement! But was iz? Iseut? Ere were sewers? The oaks of ald now they lie in peat yet elms leap where askes lay. Phall if you but will, rise you must: and none so soon either shall the pharce for the nunce come to a setdown secular phoenish.
segments.draft: 何等意愿逆抗常行，牡蛎神扼制游鱼神！布雷凯克、凯凯克、凯凯克、凯凯克！科阿克斯、科阿克斯、科阿克斯！呜阿鲁、呜阿鲁、呜阿鲁！夸喔哇！此间弯刀党仍要算伏玛拉基·小偏头，凡尔登氏投石猛轰，誓把兜帽角白衣童的吃人弹道打将出来。短标枪与回旋镖风暴。泥坯孽种，吓煞我也！荣光圣血，快救！兵刃警钟齐鸣，骇人心魄。杀林连环杀：丧钟响，买路钱。何等机缘搂抱，何等岩堡通堂穿风！何等“命我相爱”，蒙何等“我赦免你”的赦罪者罪诱！何等真情抚摸草毛长子，伴随何等假雅各打嗝的苍莽嗓音！且听且看霍斯如何扑跌尘暮，沦为奸淫者之父，然而，（哎呀我那朗星与肉身！）软性广告的天标又如何像神殿风翼横跨极高天际！但那是谁？伊索尔德？下水道修通之前？古栎如今伏于泥炭，榆木却从伏灰之处跃出。任你阳落，势必再起：而此刻这出闹剧，绝无可能过早沉落为百世涅槃的终场。

notes.lemma: wills gen wonts
notes.text: wills 与 wonts 连缀，兼指意愿与习性；gen 承德语 gegen 与古英语 gegn（对抗）。正文译为“意愿逆抗常行”，保留动作对立。

notes.lemma: oystrygods gaggin fishygods
notes.text: Ostrogoths（东哥特人）与 Visigoths（西哥特人）化为牡蛎与游鱼之神；gaggin 兼指窒息、作呕与封口。正文译作“牡蛎神扼制游鱼神”，保留历史争战与水产意象。

notes.lemma: Brékkek Kékkek ... Kóax Kóax ...
notes.text: Brékkek／Kóax 可听出阿里斯托芬《蛙》的合唱声影。它不能一并证明 Ualu、Quaouauh 各自典故；后两串先按不同拟音保留，具体解释待核。

notes.lemma: Baddelaries partisans ... Malachus Micgranes
notes.text: Baddelaries 兼指中世纪短弯刀（badelaire）、火炮与交战党徒；Malachus 令人联想到爱尔兰高王玛拉基二世（Malachi II）与旧约玛拉基书；Micgranes 兼含偏头痛（meegrims）与微粒。mathmaster 指算伏或制胜。

notes.lemma: Verdons catapelting ... Whoyteboyce of Hoodie Head
notes.text: Verdons 指盎格鲁-诺曼定居家族 Verdon，兼含凡尔登（Verdun）；catapelting 拟投石机抛射；camibalistics 融食人肉（cannibalistic）与弹道（ballistics）；Whoyteboyce 指十八世纪爱尔兰抗租农民秘密结社“白衣社”（Whiteboys）；Hoodie Head 隐指霍斯角（Howth Head）及戴兜帽者。

notes.lemma: Assiegates and boomeringstroms
notes.text: Assiegates 拼合祖鲁投掷短矛（assegai）与大门（gates）；boomeringstroms 拼合澳洲土著回旋镖（boomerang）与旋涡湍流（maelstrom / 德语 Strom）。正文取“短标枪与回旋镖风暴”。

notes.lemma: Sod's brood, be me fear! Sanglorians, save!
notes.text: Sod's brood 谐上帝之血（God's blood）并兼泥土孽种（sod）；be me fear 谐惊煞我也（by my fear）；Sanglorians 兼圣血（Sang royal）、荣耀者与都柏林主保圣人圣劳伦斯（St. Lawrence O'Toole）。正文译为“泥坯孽种，吓煞我也！荣光圣血，快救！”

notes.lemma: Arms apeal with larms, appalling
notes.text: Arms 兼军械与双臂；apeal 兼呼吁（appeal）与鸣钟（peal）；larms 简缩警报（alarms）；appalling 呼应骇人声浪。正文以“兵刃警钟齐鸣，骇人心魄”补偿四重押韵与头韵。

notes.lemma: Killykillkilly: a toll, a toll
notes.text: kill 反复重叠，兼指爱尔兰诸多地名所冠教会或树林前缀 Cill / Killy；toll 兼指敲丧钟、代价与买路关税。正文译作“杀林连环杀：丧钟响，买路钱”。

notes.lemma: What chance cuddleys, what cashels aired and ventilated!
notes.text: chance cuddleys 连读大法官（chancellor）与拥抱（cuddles），亦隐喻早期爱尔兰修道士（Culdees）；cashels 指爱尔兰芒斯特古王都卡舍尔（Cashel）磐石要塞与城堡（castles）；aired and ventilated 兼有曝光破拆与穿风透气之意。

notes.lemma: What bidimetoloves sinduced by what tegotetabsolvers!
notes.text: bidimetoloves 取自 Robert Herrick 抒情诗《致安西娅》首句“Bid me to live, and I will live... Bid me to love, and I will give / A loving heart to thee”；sinduced 融罪孽（sin）与诱惑（seduced）；tegotetabsolvers 嵌合天主教拉丁文赦罪经文公式“Ego te absolvo”（我赦免你）与赦罪神甫（absolvers）。

notes.lemma: What true feeling for their's hayair with what strawng voice of false jiccup!
notes.text: 承接创世记27章以撒摸索雅各手腕毛皮之典：feeling 指抚触感受；hayair 三叠毛发（hair）、继承人（heir）与干草（hay）；strawng 兼粗重（strong）与稻草（straw）；false jiccup 兼指假雅各（Jacob）之声与打嗝（hiccup）。

notes.lemma: how hoth sprowled met the duskt the father of fornicationists
notes.text: sprowled 可叠听 sprawled（摊倒）；duskt 牵动 dust／dusk（尘土／黄昏）。father of fornicationists 可联系始祖与坠落叙事。here here how hoth 本身不能组成 HCE 首字母藏头，不据此确认人物身份。

notes.lemma: fanespanned most high heaven the skysign of soft advertisement
notes.text: fanespanned 融合神殿（fane）、风标（vane）、展屏（fan）与凌跨（spanned）；skysign 兼指天象彩虹（创世记神与挪亚立约之记号）与高空广告天标；soft advertisement 兼指商业软广告与天恩柔和显现。地上巨人仆倒与天上虹霓升起构成强烈的上下对照。

notes.lemma: But was iz? Iseut? Ere were sewers?
notes.text: 短促三问：was iz（究竟何物 / 可是此人）；Iseut（爱尔兰传奇女主角伊索尔德 Iseult）；Ere were sewers（下水道修建之前 / 抑或修女 sisters 出现之前）。将英雄传奇骤然拉入近代城市排污系统。

notes.lemma: The oaks of ald now they lie in peat yet elms leap where askes lay
notes.text: oaks of ald 指古老栎树（oaks of old）与市政长老（alderman），沉埋于爱尔兰泥炭沼（peat）；elms leap 与 askes lay 形成镜像回文与音响对跃；askes 兼指灰烬（ashes）与梣木（ash trees），亦令人联想北欧神话最初由梣木与榆木化生之男女（Ask and Embla）。

notes.lemma: Phall if you but will, rise you must: ... secular phoenish
notes.text: Phall、rise、pharce、nunce、phoenish 把坠落、升起、闹剧与近似凤凰的声形连缀。此处保存局部回返读路，暂不推成全书定论。

segments.original: Bygmester Finnegan, of the Stuttering Hand, freemen's maurer, lived in the broadest way immarginable in his rushlit toofarback for messuages before joshuan judges had given us numbers or Helviticus committed deuteronomy (one yeastyday he sternely struxk his tete in a tub for to watsch the future of his fates but ere he swiftly stook it out again, by the might of moses, the very water was eviparated and all the guenneses had met their exodus so that ought to show you what a pentschanjeuchy chap he was!) and during mighty odd years this man of hod, cement and edifices in Toper's Thorp piled buildung supra buildung pon the banks for the livers by the Soangso. He addle liddle phifie Annie ugged the little craythur. Wither hayre in honds tuck up your part inher. Oftwhile balbulous, mithre ahead, with goodly trowel in grasp and ivoroiled overalls which he habitacularly fondseed, like Haroun Childeric Eggeberth he would caligulate by multiplicables the alltitude and malltitude until he seesaw by neatlight of the liquor wheretwin 'twas born, his roundhead staple of other days to rise in undress maisonry upstanded (joygrantit!), a waalworth of a skyerscape of most eyeful hoyth entowerly, erigenating from next to nothing and celescalating the himals and all, hierarchitectitiptitoploftical, with a burning bush abob off its baubletop and with larrons o'toolers clittering up and tombles a'buckets clottering down.
segments.draft: 建筑大师芬尼根，抖颤结巴之手，自由石匠宗师，在散草微明的远古老巢活得漫无涯际、不可度量，远在房产田契面世之前，早于约书亚士师颁降民数，亦早于瑞士利未记犯下申命重罪（某番醉意蒸腾之日，他严严实实把脑袋栽入大盆，意欲勘测未来命运，怎奈尚未抽身拔出，凭摩西神威，盆水竟已蒸发殆尽，健力士黑啤全数出逃出埃及，足见他是何等摩西五经兼木偶闹剧的狠角！）；在漫长古怪岁序里，这位灰浆桶、水泥与大厦之雄，在醉客村沿某某河岸，为临河居客层层叠叠堆造楼宇大厦。他有娇小娇妻安妮，他也狠抱这瓶玉液生灵。手执秀发，且挽你的舞伴双双入内。时而结巴踉跄，头戴方帽，手握称心泥刀，身着惯常钟爱的油布工装，宛若哈伦·希尔德里克·埃格伯特，以乘法度量崇高极顶与稠密众生，直至借着诞生之际的纯酒清光，恍见昔日圆头主桩以素面石工拔地峙立（天赐大悦！），化作一座通体赫然耸立、极尽耀眼的摩天崇楼，起于虚无，梯接天穹，凌跨群山，巍峨极顶巨匠耸拔无双，塔顶华珠之上浮摇着不烬荆棘，伴随奥图尔圣盗铿锵爬升，翻滚木桶稀里哗啦轰然坠落。

notes.lemma: Bygmester Finnegan / freemen's maurer
notes.text: Bygmester 取挪威语《建筑大师》（易卜生作 Bygmester Solness），将建筑师登高坠落母题融入主角；Finnegan 承接爱尔兰民谣《芬尼根守灵夜》中醉酒跌落脚手架复生的泥水匠蒂姆·芬尼根；freemen's maurer 承德语 Freimaurer（共济会自由石匠）。正文译作“建筑大师芬尼根，自由石匠宗师”。

notes.lemma: Stuttering Hand
notes.text: Stuttering Hand 可把结巴声、营造者的手和书写动作叠读。这是项目解释；目前没有具体外证支持某种共济会手势，不据此确认。

notes.lemma: broadest way immarginable in his rushlit toofarback for messuages
notes.text: immarginable 融不可想象（unimaginable）与无法外边缘（unmarginable）；rushlit 指以散草灯芯照亮之古风；messuages 指法律上的宅第田产。指芬尼根存在于法权田宅设立之前的洪荒古纪。

notes.lemma: joshuan judges had given us numbers or Helviticus committed deuteronomy
notes.text: 按次序连缀旧约五卷：约书亚记（Joshua）、士师记（Judges）、民数记（Numbers）、利未记（Leviticus，嵌瑞士 Helvetia）、申命记（Deuteronomy）；“犯下申命重罪”将书名拟为罪行。正文保留书卷次序与动作。

notes.lemma: one yeastyday ... struxk his tete in a tub for to watsch the future of his fates
notes.text: yeastyday 融昨日（yesterday）与酿酒酵母（yeasty）；tete 取法文头颅（tête）；watsch 兼看（watch）、洗（wash）与德语耳光（Watsche）。指芬尼根醉中将头埋入水盆勘验命运。

notes.lemma: water was eviparated and all the guenneses had met their exodus
notes.text: eviparated 融蒸发（evaporated）与毒蛇（viper）；guenneses 融都柏林著名健力士黑啤（Guinness）与创世记（Genesis）；exodus 对应出埃及记。整句以盆水蒸干、啤酒喝尽戏仿摩西过红海与出埃及。

notes.lemma: what a pentschanjeuchy chap he was!
notes.text: 双关高密度连缀：融摩西五经（Pentateuch）与英格兰经典木偶剧“庞奇与朱迪”（Punch and Judy）。兼具神圣律法始祖与市井滑稽闹剧双重品性。

notes.lemma: piled buildung supra buildung pon the banks for the livers by the Soangso
notes.text: buildung 将造楼与词形变造并置；banks、livers 牵动河岸、住客及身体声义。Soangso 正文暂取“某某河”；黄河、Saône 等具体河名链尚未核实，不据此固定地理。

notes.lemma: He addle liddle phifie Annie ugged the little craythur
notes.text: 语法双折句：直读为芬尼根拥抱小娇妻安妮（ALP 首度以妻子面貌隐现）；折读则取爱尔兰俚语 craythur（creature / 威士忌烈酒），直指民谣中芬尼根嗜酒成性、“与酒同生”。

notes.lemma: Wither hayre in honds tuck up your part inher
notes.text: 谐仿爱尔兰民谣《芬尼根守灵夜》舞曲过门呼叫“Whack fol the dah now, dance to your partner”（挽起舞伴跳起来），兼融“执发在手”（With her hair in hands）与夫妇谐谑（tuck up your part in her）。

notes.lemma: like Haroun Childeric Eggeberth he would caligulate by multiplicables the alltitude and malltitude
notes.text: Haroun Childeric Eggeberth 三名字首字母嵌合 HCE：阿拉伯阿拔斯王朝哈伦·拉希德（Haroun al-Raschid）、法兰克墨洛温王朝希尔德里克（Childeric）、威塞克斯国王埃格伯特（Egbert）；caligulate 融计算（calculate）与罗马暴君卡里古拉（Caligula）；alltitude and malltitude 叠合全部高度（altitude）与群众广度（magnitude）。

notes.lemma: a waalworth of a skyerscape of most eyeful hoyth entowerly
notes.text: waalworth 兼指纽约早期著名摩天大楼伍尔沃斯大厦（Woolworth Building）与墙垣价值（wall worth）；skyerscape 为摩天楼（skyscraper）；eyeful hoyth 兼极为养眼之高耸（eyeful height）与霍斯角（Howth）；entowerly 为全然筑成塔（entirely / en-tower）。

notes.lemma: erigenating from next to nothing and celescalating the himals and all
notes.text: erigenating 融起源（originating）与中世纪爱尔兰哲人约翰·司各特·爱留根纳（Johannes Scotus Eriugena），指涉其《自然区分论》关于万有源于神圣虚无之学说；celescalating 融天宇（celestial）与升级攀爬（escalating）；himals 兼喜马拉雅山脉（Himalayas）。

notes.lemma: hierarchitectitiptitoploftical, with a burning bush abob off its baubletop
notes.text: 巨型组合词：hierarch（教长神圣阶层）+ architect（建筑师）+ tip-top（极顶、微醉摇晃）+ toploftical（高傲自负），模拟高塔耸入云霄之巍峨与醉汉高空摇晃之险态；burning bush 指旧约西奈山不烬荆棘，被置于塔尖顶珠（baubletop）之上。

notes.lemma: larrons o'toolers clittering up and tombles a'buckets clottering down
notes.text: 双向对位：larrons o'toolers 融盗贼（法文 larron）、都柏林石匠与都柏林主保圣人圣劳伦斯·奥图尔（St. Laurence O'Toole），发出 clittering 之声向上爬；tombles a'buckets 融翻滚跌落（tumble）、水桶（buckets）与坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·贝克特（Thomas à Becket），发出 clottering 之声向下砸。再现巴别塔建造与混乱跌落之场景。

segments.original: Of the first was he to bare arms and a name: Wassaily Booslaeugh of Riesengeborg. His crest of huroldry, in vert with ancillars, troublant, argent, a hegoak, poursuivant, horrid, horned. His scutschum fessed, with archers strung, helio, of the second.
segments.draft: 他乃首开先河、赤膊佩徽并受赐名号之人：巨山山民瓦西里·烈饮大侠。其纹章顶徽，绿底嵌缀侍从辅标，泛出银白惊澜，一株张角公橡作追袭状，狞恶突兀。其盾徽中贯横带，引弓待发，映出金阳第二色相。
segments.translation: 他乃首开先河、赤膊佩徽并受赐名号之人：巨山山民瓦西里·烈饮大侠。其纹章顶徽，绿底嵌缀侍从辅标，泛出银白惊澜，一株张角公橡作追袭状，狞恶突兀。其盾徽中贯横带，引弓待发，日轮承第二色，映作银白。

notes.lemma: bare arms and a name
notes.text: 戏仿莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》第五幕第一场掘墓人之语：掘墓人称唯有园丁、开沟人与造墓者继承亚当行业，亚当乃首位“佩带纹章”（bore arms）之贵人（双关赤膊掘土）。乔伊斯将 bore 改为 bare（赤膊裸臂），赋予开天辟地第一人以平民劳作与贵族纹章双重讽刺。正文译作“首开先河、赤膊佩徽并受赐名号之人”。

notes.lemma: Wassaily Booslaeugh of Riesengeborg
notes.text: 原型为俄罗斯诺夫哥罗德史诗歌谣（byliny）中叛逆豪饮的平民勇士瓦西里·布斯拉耶夫（Vasily Buslayev）；乔伊斯将其拼写变形为 Wassaily（融祝酒 wassail 与封臣 vassal）和 Booslaeugh（融狂饮 booze 与爱尔兰语勇士 laoch）；Riesengeborg 取德语巨山山脉（Riesengebirge，波兰捷克边境传说中巨人栖息地）与巨人生育（Riese + geboren）。正文译作“巨山山民瓦西里·烈饮大侠”。

notes.lemma: crest of huroldry, in vert with ancillars, troublant, argent, a hegoak, poursuivant, horrid, horned
notes.text: 严格依照欧洲中世纪纹章学格式戏仿：crest of huroldry 为战盔纹徽（heraldry 嵌妓女 whore 与欢呼 hurrah）；vert 为纹章术语绿色（爱尔兰绿）；ancillars 为侍从从属纹章；troublant argent 为泛出令人不安之银白色；hegoak 融公山羊（he-goat）与橡树（oak）；poursuivant 为纹章从官及作追袭状；horrid horned 为狰狞生角。正文译为“其纹章顶徽，绿底嵌缀侍从辅标，泛出银白惊澜，一株张角公橡作追袭状，狞恶突兀”。

notes.lemma: scutschum fessed, with archers strung, helio, of the second
notes.text: scutschum 可叠听 escutcheon（盾徽）、scutum（盾）等声义；fessed 接纹章横带，archers strung 接张弓。of the second 按纹章述色顺序承接前文第二种颜色 argent，即银白，不能凭日光联想改成金色。helio 的日轮声影暂作译者判断。

segments.original: Hootch is for husbandman handling his hoe. Hohohoho, Mister Finn, you're going to be Mister Finnagain! Comeday morm and, O, you're vine! Sendday's eve and, ah, you're vinegar! Hahahaha, Mister Funn, you're going to be fined again!
segments.draft: 私酿烈酒归把锄农夫。嗬嗬嗬嗬，芬先生，你终归还要再当一次芬先生！来日清晨，哎呀，你宛若纯美葡萄藤；遣召前夕，唉呀，你已化作苦酸醋！哈哈哈哈，乐子先生，你又要遭判重罚了！
segments.translation: 私酿烈酒归把锄农夫。嗬嗬嗬嗬，芬先生，你终归还要再当一次芬先生！来日清晨，哎呀，你宛若纯美葡萄藤；遣召前夕，唉呀，你已化作苦酸醋！哈哈哈哈，乐子先生，你又要遭判重罚了！

notes.lemma: Hootch is for husbandman handling his hoe
notes.text: 戏仿英格兰初级识字童谣（如“A is for Apple”），以字母 H 之发音（爱尔兰英语读 Haitch）连缀四次：Hootch（私酿烈酒）、husbandman（农夫/丈夫）、handling（操持）、hoe（锄头）。兼有土地耕作与生殖力勃发之双重隐喻。正文译作“私酿烈酒归把锄农夫”。

notes.lemma: Mister Finn, you're going to be Mister Finnagain!
notes.text: Finnagain 叠听 Finn again（芬又回来），本段重唱因而带出回返意味；可与书名互照，但不能据这一处宣称已解释全书结构。

notes.lemma: Comeday morm and, O, you're vine! Sendday's eve and, ah you're vinegar!
notes.text: Comeday morm 为来日（Someday/Sunday morn）星期日清晨圣餐之生机，vine 兼葡萄藤、美酒（wine）与安好（fine）；Sendday's eve 为传票之日（send-day / Sunday eve）前夕，vinegar 为酸醋（暗示美酒变质、基督受难时尝之苦醋及宿醉酸涩）。展现狂欢与衰败交替之生理与神圣对立。正文译为“来日清晨，哎呀，你宛若纯美葡萄藤；遣召前夕，唉呀，你已化作苦酸醋！”。

notes.lemma: Mister Funn, you're going to be fined again!
notes.text: Mister Funn 谐玩笑（fun）与芬（Finn）；fined again 兼指再次遭法庭罚款（fined）与再次复活（Finn again / fine again）。狂欢作乐终须面对治安法庭之惩处，将醉酒神话拉回都柏林世俗现实。正文译作“乐子先生，你又要遭判重罚了！”。

segments.original: What then agentlike brought about that tragoady thundersday this municipal sin business? Our cubehouse still rocks as earwitness to the thunder of his arafatas but we hear also through successive ages that shebby choruysh of unkalified muzzlenimiissilehims that would blackguardise the whitestone ever hurtleturtled out of heaven. Stay us wherefore in our search for tighteousness, O Sustainer, what time we rise and when we take up to toothmick and before we lump down upown our leatherbed and in the night and at the fading of the stars! For a nod to the nabir is better than wink to the wabsanti. Otherways wesways like that provost scoffing bedoueen the jebel and the jpysian sea. Cropherb the crunchbracken shall decide. Then we'll know if the feast is a flyday. She has a gift of seek on site and she allcasually ansars helpers, the dreamydeary. Heed! Heed! It may half been a missfired brick, as some say, or it mought have been due to a collupsus of his back promises, as others looked at it. (There extand by now one thousand and one stories, all told, of the same). But so sore did abe ite ivvy's holired abbles, (what with the wallhall's horrors of rollsrights, carhacks, stonengens, kisstvanes, tramtrees, fargobawlers, autokinotons, hippohobbilies, streetfleets, tournintaxes, megaphoggs, circuses and wardsmoats and basilikerks and aeropagods and the hoyse and the jollybrool and the peeler in the coat and the mecklenburk bitch bite at his ear and the merlinburrow burrocks and his fore old porecourts, the bore the more, and his blightblack workingstacks at twelvepins a dozen and the noobibusses sleighding along Safetyfirst Street and the derryjellybies snooping around Tell-No-Tailors' Corner and the fumes and the hopes and the strupithump of his ville's indigenous romekeepers, homesweepers, domecreepers, thurum and thurum in fancymud murumd and all the uproor from all the aufroofs, a roof for may and a reef for hugh butt under his bridge suits tony) wan warning Phill filt tippling full. His howd feeled heavy, his hoddit did shake. (There was a wall of course in erection) Dimb! He stottered from the latter. Damb! he was dud. Dumb! Mastabatoom, mastabadtomm, when a mon merries his lute is all long. For whole the world to see.
segments.draft:
究竟是何方暗手，在雷鸣星期四招致那场山羊祭献惨祸，惹发这桩满城风雨的市政罪愆？吾人六面方屋至今轰然震颤，亲耳听闻他阿拉法特山的浩荡惊雷；千秋百代以来，我们也听见那群不肖之徒发出卑鄙聒噪，妄图玷污自天穹翻滚狂坠的玄白圣石。万有扶持之主啊，为此请在我们求索严律公义之际托住我们：当我们清晨起居，当我们执持洁齿细木，当我们沉身跌卧牛皮榻上，在漫漫长夜，在晨星隐没之时！向知礼邻人点头示意，强似向苦修隐士挤眉弄眼。否则吾人将步履踉跄，宛若那在圣山与幽海间讥诮嘲弄的贝都因游民。且待嚼草巨兽踏碎蕨丛作一公断，届时自知此宴是神圣主麻日，还是蝇飞肉腐期。她生来具当场寻察之妙智，随缘抚慰一众相随辅士，这梦中温存娇娘。且听！警醒！

有人说，半因失手坠砖；亦有人看作，全系背弃前约引来脊骨崩塌。（关于这桩公案，迄今流传一千零一夜故事，说到底，全在讲同一遭事）。但亚当咬食夏娃的圣红苹果，啃得那般创痛巨深——（且不论那筑墙英灵殿涌现的重重魔障：劳斯莱斯、破马车、巨石机车、石棺风标、电车林立、镖局商贩、活动电影机、马车怪物、满街车队、转弯计程车、浓烟巨号、环岛城壕、大殿宝塔、吊机喧叫与放浪狂呼、裹紧大氅的警探、梅克伦堡街荡妇在耳畔啃咬、马尔堡军营、四大老法院越老越烦人、一打十二枚焦黑工棚、新式大巴在安全第一大街飞滑、德里糖贩窥探赖账死角，更有全城土著守房人、扫街妇、爬顶贼掀腾的气雾、期冀与沉钝践踏，在泥浆砖墙间穿梭往返，更有所有屋顶倾泻的震天喧嚣：给玛丽屋顶，给休暗礁，唯他桥墩之下，足供浪客容身）——某个清晨，菲尔喝得酩酊大醉。他手中灰斗发沉，他顶上脑袋直晃。（身旁当然正砌建一堵高墙）。扑通！他从梯上踉跄跌落。咚！他成了死尸。一片死寂！平顶石墓，轰隆丧鼓，男人娶妻成婚，琴弦尽舒张。任凭举世看个分明。

notes.lemma: agentlike
notes.text: agentlike 兼暗中唆使之代理人（agent provocateur）、警探内线与历史动因；呼应都柏林凤凰公园双重暗杀公案中受暗手挑唆之阴影。正文译作“何方暗手”。

notes.lemma: tragoady thundersday this municipal sin business
notes.text: tragoady 拆解希腊语悲剧词源 tragōidia（tragos 山羊 + ōidē 歌咏，即山羊祭献惨剧）并融 toad（癞蛤蟆）；thundersday 融北欧雷神索尔之日（Thursday / Thor's day）与天谴神雷；municipal sin business 紧扣 HCE 在都柏林凤凰公园引发满城风雨的市政性丑闻与原罪公案。正文译作“在雷鸣星期四招致那场山羊祭献惨祸，惹发这桩满城风雨的市政罪愆”。

notes.lemma: cubehouse still rocks as earwitness to the thunder of his arafatas
notes.text: cubehouse 可先读作方屋；earwitness 将听见与见证并置。联系克尔白、阿拉法特山及宗教惊雷，暂作本段声义场中的译者提议，不当作已证词源或确定取材。

notes.lemma: shebby choruysh of unkalified muzzlenimiissilehims that would blackguardise the whitestone ever hurtleturtled out of heaven
notes.text: 《提尔密济圣训》877 记玄石来自天园，原白而因人的罪变黑，可供 whitestone／blackguardise 对读。这一文本平行不独自证明 Joyce 的取材路径；其他混合词拆读仍待核。

notes.lemma: Stay us wherefore in our search for tighteousness, O Sustainer, what time we rise and when we take up to toothmick and before we lump down upown our leatherbed and in the night and at the fading of the stars!
notes.text: 《古兰经》52:48–49 涉及起立、夜间与星退时颂赞，可与此处起居和星隐的节奏并读。Sustainer 的具体神名、toothmick 与洁齿木等联系尚未核实，不据首页链接担保整串语言链。

notes.lemma: For a nod to the nabir is better than wink to the wabsanti. Otherways wesways like that provost scoffing bedoueen the jebel and the jpysian sea.
notes.text: 前句可叠听 nod、neighbour 与 wink 的谚语声影。provost 可指教务长或长官，此处具体人物尚待核实，正文保留长官这一主体；bedoueen 叠听 between 与 Bedouin，贝都因声影留在注中。nabir、wabsanti 及 jpysian 的多语拆读仍待逐项核证，不据此断定单一词源。

notes.lemma: Cropherb the crunchbracken shall decide. Then we'll know if the feast is a flyday.
notes.text: Cropherb／crunchbracken 可引出牧食、草、咀嚼等读路。正文暂取嚼草者形象；是否特指《约伯记》巨兽尚未核，不作唯一指认。feast／flyday 的宴席、飞蝇与节日声影也属译者提议。

notes.lemma: She has a gift of seek on site and she allcasually ansars helpers, the dreamydeary. Heed! Heed!
notes.text: ansars 与 answers、helpers 可在此相互牵动；把它联系麦地那辅士只是待核读路，不能凭近音坐实人物或史实。此处保留回应、援助与梦中女子的声义并置。

notes.lemma: missfired brick, as some say, or it mought have been due to a collupsus of his back promises
notes.text: 芬尼根从脚手架跌落原因之双重视角：外因归咎于建筑失手飞砖（missfired brick / half been）；内因归咎于背信毁诺（breach of promise / back promises）引发道德崩塌、生理器官脱垂（collupsus < collapse + prolapsus）及脊梁骨受挫。正文译作“半因失手坠砖；亦有人看作，全系背弃前约引来脊骨崩塌”。

notes.lemma: There extand by now one thousand and one stories, all told, of the same
notes.text: 互文《一千零一夜》（The Arabian Nights），兼点全书总纲：世间流传千千万万神话轶闻变体，说到底全在讲述同一遭事（all told, of the same）——即人类之坠落与重生。正文译作“关于这桩公案，迄今流传一千零一夜故事，说到底，全在讲同一遭事”。

notes.lemma: so sore did abe ite ivvy's holired abbles
notes.text: 创世记第3章原罪堕落之变体拼写：abe 为亚当（Adam / Abraham）、ite 为咬食（ate）、ivvy 为夏娃（Eve / 常春藤 ivy）、holired 为神圣纯红（holy red / hollowed）、abbles 为苹果（apples）；兼有生理咬齿之创痛（sore）。正文译作“亚当咬食夏娃的圣红苹果，啃得那般创痛巨深”。

notes.lemma: wallhall's horrors of rollsrights, carhacks, stonengens, kisstvanes, tramtrees, fargobawlers, autokinotons, hippohobbilies, streetfleets, tournintaxes, megaphoggs, circuses and wardsmoats and basilikerks and aeropagods
notes.text: 长列都市怪物名录：wallhall 融北欧英灵殿（Valhalla）与筑墙之殿（Wall-hall）；rollsrights 融劳斯莱斯（Rolls-Royce）与翻滚之权；carhacks 融出租马车与劈砍；stonengens 融巨石阵（Stonehenge）与蒸汽引擎；kisstvanes 融史前石棺（kistvaens）与亲吻风标；fargobawlers 融富国银行镖局马车与大声叫卖商贩；autokinotons 融活动电影机（kinetoscope）与自动机；basilikerks 为巴西利卡大教堂与基督教会；aeropagods 为雅典战神山法庭（Areopagus）与宝塔（pagodas）。正文全面对应译出。

notes.lemma: peeler in the coat and the mecklenburk bitch bite at his ear and the merlinburrow burrocks and his fore old porecourts, the bore the more
notes.text: 都柏林现实地理与执法司法历史：peeler 为罗伯特·皮尔爵士设立之爱尔兰警察；mecklenburk bitch 指梅克伦堡街红灯区妓女（见《尤利西斯》“夜镇”）；merlinburrow 为马尔堡军营（Marlborough Barracks）；porecourts 指都柏林四法院（Four Courts）、四大编年史家（Four Masters）与爱尔兰语大路（bóthar mór），越老越显烦人（the bore the more）。正文译作“裹紧大氅的警探、梅克伦堡街荡妇在耳畔啃咬、马尔堡军营、四大老法院越老越烦人”。

notes.lemma: wan warning Phill filt tippling full. His howd feeled heavy, his hoddit did shake
notes.text: 直接化用爱尔兰民谣《芬尼根守灵夜》第一节：“One morning Tim was rather full, / His head felt heavy, which made him shake”；wan warning 兼某个清晨（One morning）与预警（One warning）；Phill 为爱尔兰芬尼根变体；howd 兼瓦泥灰斗（hod）与丹麦语头颅（hoved）；hoddit 兼挪威语头颅（hodet）。正文译作“某个清晨，菲尔喝得酩酊大醉。他手中灰斗发沉，他顶上脑袋直晃”。

notes.lemma: Dimb! He stottered from the latter. Damb! he was dud. Dumb!
notes.text: 坠落、殒命与死寂之三联爆破拟声词（Dimb! Damb! Dumb!）：stottered 兼苏格兰语踉跄（stotter）与口吃（stutter）；latter 兼梯子（ladder）与后者；dud 兼死尸（dud）与未爆弹；Dumb 为哑然无声。正文译作“扑通！他从梯上踉跄跌落。咚！他成了死尸。一片死寂！”。

notes.lemma: Mastabatoom, mastabadtomm, when a mon merries his lute is all long. For whole the world to see
notes.text: Mastabatoom／mastabadtomm 叠出 mastaba 石墓、墓穴及鼓点声影；结婚与琴弦的读法暂作项目比较。未核具体民谣版本，不称原词引文。

segments.original: Shize? I should shee! Macool, Macool, orra whyi deed ye diie? of a trying thirstay mournin? Sobs they sighdid at Fillagain's chrissormiss wake, all the hoolivans of the nation, prostrated in their consternation and their duodisimally profusive plethora of ululation. There was plumbs and grumes and cheriffs and citherers and raiders and cinemen too. And the all gianed in with the shoutmost shoviality. Agog and magog and the round of them agrog. To the continuation of that celebration until Hanandhunigan's extermination! Some in kinkin corass, more, kankan keening. Belling him up and filling him down. He's stiff but he's steady is Priam Olim! 'Twas he was the dacent gaylabouring youth. Sharpen his pillowscone, tap up his bier! E'erawhere in this whorl would ye hear sich a din again? With their deepbrow fundigs and the dusty fidelios. They laid him brawdawn alanglast bed. With a bockalips of finisky fore his feet. And a barrowload of guenesis hoer his head. Tee the tootal of the fluid hang the twoddle of the fuddled, O! Hurrah, there is but young gleve for the owl globe wheels in view which is tautaulogically the same thing. Well, Him a being so on the flounder of his bulk like an overgrown babeling, let wee peep, see, at Hom, well, see peegee ought he ought, platterplate. Hum! From Shopalist to Bailywick or from ashtun to baronoath or from Buythebanks to Roundthehead or from the foot of the bill to ireglint's eye he calmly extensolies. And all the way (a horn!) from fjord to fjell his baywinds' oboboes shall wail him rockbound (hoahoahoah!) in swimswamswum and all the livvylong night, the delldale dalppling night, the night of bluerybells, her flittaflute in tricky trochees (O carina! O carina!) wake him. With her issavan essavans and her patterjackmartins about all them inns and ouses. Tilling a teel of a tum, telling a toll of a teary turty Taubling. Grace before Glutton. For what we are, gifs à gross if we are, about to believe. So pool the begg and pass the kish for crawsake. Omen. So sigh us. Grampupus is fallen down but grinny sprids the boord. Whase on the joint of a desh? Finfoefom the Fush. Whase be his baken head? A loaf of Singpantry's Kennedy bread. And whase hitched to the hop in his tayle? A glass of Danu U'Dunnell's foamous olde Dobbelin ayle. But, lo, as you would quaffoff his fraudstuff and sink teeth through that pyth of a flowerwhite bodey behold of him as behemoth for he is noewhemoe. Finiche! Only a fadograph of a yestern scene.
segments.draft:
尺码？当真骇人！麦库尔，麦库尔，哎呀你因何撒手人寰，偏选在这般熬人的焦渴周四清晨？在再斟芬先生的圣诞守灵宴上，全国各路浪荡阿飞齐声吞声抽泣，惊骇中仆伏倒地，倾泻十二分充沛的号丧长嚎。场上备足李子干、凝血浆、带刀警长、拨琴乐手、突袭马贼，外加各路影人。众人如巨人裂口哄然相随，爆发出最震天的泼酒欢呼。歌革与玛各两相惊呆，团团围坐痛饮浊酒。守灵庆典通宵达旦，直至芬尼根合族尽绝方休！有人宗族合唱，更多人跳康康舞嚎丧。钟声仰面敬告，酒浆直灌肚肠。昔日老王普里阿摩斯通体挺僵，却稳如泰山！当年正是这名体面勤苦的乐天后生。拍松他枕头石，敲开他停尸酒桶！寰宇漩涡之内，何处能再闻这等喧天震响？伴着深蹙双眉的掘墓葬仪，还有蒙尘的忠烈长歌。众人将他宽展平置于终末长榻。脚前供一瓶终极威士忌启示录，头顶安一车健力士创世啤酒。任酒浆滔滔流淌，管醉汉胡话连篇，哎呀！欢呼吧，苍茫老球转动在望，少年大地生机盎然——回环复归，说到底全系同一遭事！

且说，他庞大躯身如比目鱼仰面摊倒，活脱一个超常发育的巴别巨婴；且容吾人悄声偷觑，瞧瞧这位宅主尊容：翻至第八十八页，一睹盘中平卧法相。哼！自查珀利佐德至贝利灯塔区，自阿什敦至拉斯法纳姆，自河岸畔至霍斯角，自山脚直抵爱尔兰之眼岛，他安详横卧平展。一路号角吹鸣！自峡湾到群山，海湾风声如双簧管为受困岩岸的他悲号（呼啸长鸣！），在浪涛拍荡间翻滚；在漫漫长夜，在幽谷斑驳的长夜，在蓝铃花隐泣的长夜，她以飞旋短笛奏出精巧扬抑格（可人儿啊！小舟啊！），将他唤醒。她沿途细语呢喃，如飞燕穿梭周遭客栈房舍。播撒墓冢传说，敲响泥泞泪城都柏林的沉缓丧钟。暴食谢饭祷：为了吾等将要承受的大量赐福——倘若吾等果真深信不疑。那就挪开讨饭口袋，递过土豆蔑筐，权当照看肠胃饥腹。凶兆阿门。众人齐声叹息。老祖父海怪跌落倒毙，老祖母在停尸板上摆开筵席。盘中大肉是谁？芬·麦库尔化身的大鲑鱼。烤熟的头颅是谁？圣帕特里克肯尼迪大面包。系在尾巴上的酒花又是何物？一杯丹尼尔·欧康奈尔举世闻名的都柏林陈年老麦酒。然而，且看：当你痛饮他那虚妄酒浆，下口咬透他那面粉般惨白肉躯的精髓，定睛瞧他宛若陆地巨兽贝希摩斯——皆因他早已遁入虚无。终局落幕！唯余昨日光景一张褪色旧照。

notes.lemma: Shize? I should shee! Macool, Macool, orra whyi deed ye diie? of a trying thirstay mournin?
notes.text: Macool、Fillagain 及哭问何以死去，可联系芬·麦库尔与守灵歌谣。与《莫莉·布兰尼根》等曲调的进一步对应尚未核实际歌词版本；此处不作逐字引词。

notes.lemma: Sobs they sighdid at Fillagain's chrissormiss wake, all the hoolivans of the nation, prostrated in their consternation and their duodisimally profusive plethora of ululation
notes.text: Fillagain 将芬尼根（Finnegan）点化为酒宴再斟一杯（fill again）；chrissormiss 融圣诞节（Christmas）与基督或错过（Chris or miss）；hoolivans 融爱尔兰姓氏奥苏利万（O'Sullivan）与街头阿飞（Hooligan）；duodisimally profusive 融十二进制（duodecimal / 十二门徒 / 十二陪审员）与极其凄惨（dismal）；ululation 为爱尔兰传统守灵号丧。正文译作“在再斟芬先生的圣诞守灵宴上，全国各路浪荡阿飞齐声吞声抽泣，惊骇中仆伏倒地，倾泻十二分充沛的号丧长嚎”。

notes.lemma: plumbs and grumes and cheriffs and citherers and raiders and cinemen too. And the all gianed in with the shout-most shoviality. Agog and magog and the round of them agrog
notes.text: 守灵茶点与吊客杂烩：plumbs（李子/铅锤）、grumes（凝血块/酸葡萄）、cheriffs（樱桃/治安官 sheriffs）、citherers（齐特琴手/苹果酒商 ciderers）、raiders（劫掠者/骑士）、cinemen（肉桂/影人 cinema men）；all gianed in 融全部加入（all joined in）与巨人裂嘴（gianed / giant）；Agog and magog 融圣经末日审判双巨兽歌革与玛各（Gog and Magog，亦为伦敦巨人立像）与瞠目结舌（agog）；agrog 为大饮朗姆酒（grog）。正文全面生动对应译出。

notes.lemma: Some in kinkin corass, more, kankan keening. Belling him up and filling him down
notes.text: 守灵场面之声色骚动：kinkin corass 融亲族合唱（kith and kin chorus）与康康舞紧身胸甲（can-can cuirass）；kankan keening 为跳着康康舞狂暴嚎丧（keening）；Belling him up 为丧钟鸣响敬告与腹部朝上（belly up）；filling him down 为灌满酒浆。正文译作“有人宗族合唱，更多人跳康康舞嚎丧。钟声仰面敬告，酒浆直灌肚肠”。

notes.lemma: He's stiff but he's steady is Priam Olim! 'Twas he was the dacent gaylabouring youth
notes.text: stiff／steady 与 Priam／olim 可把僵直、稳立、古王及昔日并读；与守灵民谣套语的联系暂作项目声形比较。未核具体歌词，不据此确认逐字借用。

notes.lemma: Sharpen his pillowscone, tap up his bier! E'erawhere in this whorl would ye hear sich a din again? With their deepbrow fundigs and the dusty fidelios
notes.text: pillowscone 融枕头与司空石（Stone of Scone，历代苏格兰与英国君主加冕石）；tap up his bier 兼敲实灵柩板与敲开啤酒桶（beer tap）；in this whorl 融尘世（world）与涡旋（whorl）；sich a din again 谐芬尼根之名（Finn again）；deepbrow fundigs 兼深锁双眉之葬礼（fundus / digging）与寻欢作乐（fun-digs）；dusty fidelios 融蒙尘忠仆与贝多芬唯一歌剧《费黛里奥》（Fidelio，象征忠贞不渝）。正文全面对应译出。

notes.lemma: They laid him brawdawn alanglast bed. With a bockalips of finisky fore his feet. And a barrowload of guenesis hoer his head
notes.text: 民谣守灵夜停尸陈设之神圣升华：民谣原唱“脚前一加仑威士忌，头顶一桶波特酒”，在此演化为整部基督教圣经之首尾呼应：bockalips of finisky 融博克黑啤酒（bock）、新约终卷《启示录》（Apocalypse）与终结（finis）威士忌；barrowload of guenesis 融手推车/坟冢（barrow）、旧约首卷《创世记》（Genesis）与都柏林名酿健力士黑啤（Guinness）。脚前启示录，头顶创世记，死中孕生。正文译作“众人将他宽展平置于终末长榻。脚前供一瓶终极威士忌启示录，头顶安一车健力士创世啤酒”。

notes.lemma: Tee the tootal of the fluid hang the twoddle of the fuddled, O! Hurrah, there is but young gleve for the owl globe wheels in view which is tautaulogically the same thing
notes.text: 流体、醉话、年轻与衰老、轮转与同一的声义在此连缀。与《菲尔的笛手舞会》等歌谣的关系尚待核实际歌词；不把现有拟音判断写成直接引文。

notes.lemma: Him a being so on the flounder of his bulk like an overgrown babeling
notes.text: 芬尼根/HCE 跌落倒地姿态之多重隐喻：flounder 双关比目鱼（平摊于盘中）与挣扎翻滚；overgrown babeling 兼发育过硕的巨婴（baby）与巴别塔遗民（Babeling）；Hom 兼家园（Home）与 HCE 的简写代码。正文译作“庞大躯身如比目鱼仰面摊倒，活脱一个超常发育的巴别巨婴”。

notes.lemma: see peegee ought he ought, platterplate
notes.text: see peegee ought he ought 可听作“see page eighty-eight”（见第88页）。Troy 据此联到 Moret《埃及诸王与诸神》：1911 年版第88页后插入图版 X，图题为“死去的奥西里斯－乌恩内弗之守灵”，注明阿拜多斯、塞提一世神庙。Troy 将此联系归给 Maciej Slomczynski；这里只交代该文所记归属，不断定首发者。platterplate 叠合 platter（盘）与 plate（图版），兼留盘中横陈之意。图版吻合仍不足以单独证明 Joyce 的用书路径。

notes.lemma: From Shopalist to Bailywick or from ashtun to baronoath or from Buythebanks to Roundthehead or from the foot of the bill to ireglint's eye he calmly extensolies
notes.text: 这串地名可把巨人躯体与都柏林地景叠读：Shopalist 可联系 Chapelizod，Bailywick 可联系 Baily 灯塔，ashtun 可联系 Ashtown，ireglint's eye 可联系 Ireland's Eye。baronoath 暂音译“巴罗诺斯”，另有与 Howth 爵位相连的读法，尚不能径定为 Rathfarnham。各处对应仍待核实，不作严格地图；extensolies 叠听延伸与安躺。

notes.lemma: all the livvylong night, the delldale dalppling night, the night of bluerybells, her flittaflute in tricky trochees (O carina! O carina!) wake him. With her issavan essavans and her patterjackmartins about all them inns and ouses. Tilling a teel of a tum, telling a toll of a teary turty Taubling
notes.text: 女主角 ALP（利菲河）化作夜曲与风声唤醒沉睡巨人：livvylong night 融整夜（livelong）与利菲河（Liffey）；delldale dalppling 描摹溪谷斑驳（dell + dale + dappling）；O carina 兼陶笛（ocarina）与意大利语爱人小舟（carina）；teary turty Taubling 典出都柏林著名昵称“亲爱的污浊都柏林”（Dear Dirty Dublin），化作泥泞泪城与丧钟。正文译作“在幽谷斑驳的长夜，在蓝铃花隐泣的长夜……敲响泥泞泪城都柏林的沉缓丧钟”。

notes.lemma: Grace before Glutton. For what we are, gifs à gross if we are, about to believe. So pool the begg and pass the kish for crawsake. Omen. So sigh us
notes.text: Grace before Glutton 把饭前谢恩与暴食并置，believe 又牵动信与领受的祷词节奏。此处仅作常见谢饭语式对读；未核《公祷书》具体页，不指定正式礼文版本。

notes.lemma: Grampupus is fallen down but grinny sprids the boord
notes.text: Grampupus 融祖父（Grandpa）与巨兽虎鲸（Grampus），指老巨人芬尼根覆灭；grinny 融祖母（Granny）与咧嘴嬉笑（grin）；boord 为餐桌兼停尸板（board）。老朽倒下，老妇在停尸台上铺开暴食盛宴。正文译作“老祖父海怪跌落倒毙，老祖母在停尸板上摆开筵席”。

notes.lemma: Whase on the joint of a desh? Finfoefom the Fush. Whase be his baken head? A loaf of Singpantry's Kennedy bread. And whase hitched to the hop in his tayle? A glass of Danu U'Dunnell's foamous olde Dobbelin ayle
notes.text: 神圣食尸（Theophagy）与爱尔兰风物：盘中鱼肉化为凯尔特神话智慧鲑鱼与芬·麦库尔（Finfoefom the Fush 融 fee-fi-fo-fum 巨人之语与鱼）；烤头颅化为都柏林帕特里克街肯尼迪名牌烤面包（Kennedy's bread）；尾巴酒花化为爱尔兰政治领袖丹尼尔·欧康奈尔（Danu U'Dunnell）之都柏林名牌老黑啤（Dublin ale）。正文完整生动译出。

notes.lemma: behold of him as behemoth for he is noewhemoe. Finiche! Only a fadograph of a yestern scene
notes.text: behemoth 典出《约伯记》40:15 创世陆地巨兽；noewhemoe 融无处复寻（nowhere more）与虚无；Finiche 融芬尼根（Finn）与法语终结（fini）/意大利语落幕（finisce）；fadograph 为乔伊斯自造名言（fade 褪色 + photograph 照片），宣告昔日创世壮举终化作机械复制时代一张泛黄褪色的老照片。正文译作“定睛瞧他宛若陆地巨兽贝希摩斯——皆因他早已遁入虚无。终局落幕！唯余昨日光景一张褪色旧照”。

segments.draft: 几乎透出红润的鲑鱼翁，自远古‘爱之巢’诸纪游来，如今在吾人晨雾中消融化散，凄凉装罐，深埋封藏。那席盛宴就此彻底散场：任人吞咽，任人分切，顺当送别这盘红鲱鱼！然而，纵在吾人深夜，在那道雷鸣翁钟爱且凭倚的游鳟溪畔，岂不仍见那巨雷鱼形朦胧沉睡，静卧于衰草丛中？邑官寝此（H.C.E.）。偎伴微婢（A.L.P.）。管她身着锦旗还是鹑衣百结，裹着煤烟破布还是主日华服，腰缠金矿万贯还是贫无立锥。啊呀，当然，谁人不怜爱小安妮·露伊妮——或该说，娇俏多雨的安娜·蕾伊妮？只见她撑起小伞，穿行泥洼水坑间，娇痴步履如舞，轻巧巧蹁跹而过。哟！大雷咆轰然沉睡，呼呼鼾息。头枕石南霍斯角，足抵伊索尔德教堂村。他那硕大颅骨乃心智渊薮，在渺渺远雾中凝睇。那是谁？正是霍斯山！他那黏土双足裹满青绿草皮，在他当年跌落处僵直挺立，紧傍军火库矮丘墙垣——当年吾家玛吉同披姐妹披巾，在彼处窥尽始末。而在‘佳人盟署’正对面，越过六十号高地（噩运接踵而至！），在堡垒后侧，咚，咚嗒咚，咚嗒咚，幽暗灌丛埋伏重重，正是三兵卒在利菲河畔静候伏击之处。因而，吉米啊，待乌云飘散，便可俯瞰吾人隆起土冢的伟岸全貌——如今已成威灵顿国家博物馆；放眼微碧远方，迷人的滑铁卢故地横陈，更有两位素白村姑掩映葱茏树影间，娇笑弄姿，尽显风流俏媚！

notes.lemma: Almost rubicund Salmosalar... woebecanned and packt away
notes.text: 大西洋鲑鱼（Salmo salar）与亚述帝王萨尔玛那萨尔（Shalmaneser）双关造词。鲑鱼在爱尔兰神话中为“智慧鲑鱼”（芬·麦库尔烹鲑吮指获无上智慧），全书借此比附巨翁沉睡化身；“woebecanned and packt away”兼指罐头鲑鱼工业封装与尸体装殓封棺。

notes.lemma: ages of the Agapemonides
notes.text: 典指19世纪英国萨默塞特郡亨利·普林斯（Henry James Prince）创立的极端享乐主义宗教公社“爱之巢”（Agapemone，源出希腊语 agape，圣爱），以“属灵新娘”与放纵丑闻轰动一时；尾缀 -ides 示“……之子孙”，喻指自远古享乐诸纪延续至今的生殖沉溺。

notes.lemma: schlook, schlice and goodridhirring
notes.text: 复合爱尔兰英语“痛快作别”（good riddance）与穷人廉价红鲱鱼（red herring）；上文“schlook, schlice”则融合德语 Schluck（大口吞咽）与英文 slice（切片），戏指守灵夜食尸筵席终告分食完毕。

notes.lemma: brontoichthyan form outlined aslumbered
notes.text: 希腊语 brontē（雷霆）与 ichthys（鱼）复合新词，兼融维柯原始神雷震悚、雷龙（Brontosaurus）与基督鱼形符号，指代沉睡于都柏林大地的史前雷霆巨怪。

notes.lemma: Hic cubat edilis. Apud libertinam parvulam.
notes.text: 戏仿古罗马拉丁墓志铭：“邑宰寝卧于此。伴其娇小获释婢。”其中拉丁文各词首字母暗藏全书男女主角姓名缩写：H.C.E.（Hic Cubat Edilis）与 A.L.P.（Apud Libertinam Parvulam）。

notes.lemma: little Anny Ruiny, or, we mean to say, lovelittle Anna Rayiny
notes.text: 戏仿19世纪末流传甚广的音乐厅名曲《小安妮·鲁尼》（Little Annie Rooney），将安娜·利维亚·普卢拉贝尔（ALP）化身为穿行于都柏林泥洼细雨中的小妇人（rain / ruin / Reine）。

notes.lemma: Upon Benn Heather, in Seeple Isout too
notes.text: 勾勒巨人横卧都柏林的对角线地貌：头枕东北爱尔兰海畔之霍斯角（爱尔兰语 Binn Éadair，即 Ben Edar，石南丛生），脚抵西南利菲河畔之伊索尔德教堂村（Chapelizod，爱尔兰语 Séipéal Iosóid）。

notes.lemma: mund of the magazine wall, where our maggy seen all, with her sisterin shawl
notes.text: 泥足典出《但以理书》第二章尼布甲尼撒异梦金头泥足巨像；“军火库墙”指都柏林菲尼克斯公园军火库（斯威夫特曾作讽刺诗）；玛吉与姊妹同披披肩窥视，指代见证 HCE 公园猥亵丑闻的双女。

notes.lemma: Wallinstone national museum... waterloose country... two quitewhite villagettes... prettilees
notes.text: 指菲尼克斯公园内威灵顿公爵纪念碑（Wallinstone < Wellington + wall/stone）；水漫利菲河谷与滑铁卢战场（Waterloo / water-loose）重叠；二村姑（villagettes）在林木间掩映吃吃娇笑，预示下文威灵顿博物馆滑铁卢战役全景展厅。

notes.lemma: museomound... janitrix, the mistress Kathe... Willingdone Museyroom
notes.text: museomound 把 museum 与 mound 叠在一起，展馆、土冢和巨人身体可相互映照。Kathe 随后引路；原文反复 Tip，可保留敲击般节拍，不据此断定她手持何种器具。

notes.lemma: Prooshious gunn... ffrinch... Cap and Soracer... Crossgunn
notes.text: Prooshious、ffrinch 可分别叠听 Prussian、French；Cap and Soracer 又像 cup and saucer。军史陈列混入餐具与儿歌语气，中文保留短句和反复“此乃”。

notes.lemma: triplewon hat of Lipoleum... Cokenhape... Sraughter Willingdone
notes.text: Lipoleum 可叠听 Napoleon、linoleum；triplewon 又让人想到 triple、won。帽子、油布与胜负相缠。Cokenhape 与后文 Copenhagen、Capeinhope 的变形须连读，不能每处都抹平为同一马名。

notes.lemma: three lipoleum boyne grouching down in the living detch... inimyskilling... scotcher grey
notes.text: grouching 可联 Grouchy，boyne 可联 Boyne，detch 近 ditch。此处也明列 inglis、scotcher grey 等兵种声影。不同战事在句中错杂，不把它校成一份准确战役名册。

notes.lemma: Assaye, assaye! Touchole Fitz Tuomush. Dirty MacDyke. And Hairy O'Hurry. All of them arminus-varminus.
notes.text: Assaye、arminus-varminus 容许战役与人名读法。阿尔米尼乌斯／瓦鲁斯的联系暂作候选，未核本题专门研究；不把三个兵童逐一固定为历史人物。

notes.lemma: jinnies with their legahorns feinting to read in their handmade's book of stralegy
notes.text: handmade's book 可叠听 handmaid，stralegy 可联 strategy；少女装作读书而另行谋划。legahorns 又近 Leghorn。人物是否等同伊茜分身仍属解释，不作事实登记。

notes.lemma: hastings dispatch... thin red lines cross the shortfront of me Belchum
notes.text: hastings、thin red lines、shortfront 把军报、战线与衣服前襟相叠。与特定战役、部队及布吕歇尔的逐项对应尚待补证，正文不靠这些指认才能成立。

notes.lemma: Salamangra! Ayi, ayi, ayi! Cherry jinnies. Figtreeyou! Damn fairy ann, Voutre. Willingdone. That was the first joke of Willingdone
notes.text: Damn fairy ann, Voutre 可联法语粗话与英语骂语。原交稿引“Publish and be damned”及威尔逊回忆录，本轮未核其与此句的证据链，故撤去直接引语和确定归属。

notes.lemma: Canon Futter with the popynose after his hundred days' indulgence
notes.text: Canon Futter 可叠听 cannon fodder（炮灰），canon 又可指教士；popynose、hundred days' indulgence 让军旅与教会用语交错。中文宜留下炮与教士两层。

notes.lemma: Almeidagad! Arthiz too loose! Brum! Brum! Cumbrum! Underwetter! Goat: strip Finnlambs!
notes.text: Almeidagad、Arthiz too loose、Cumbrum、Goat strip Finnlambs 可供战役名、惊呼与外语声串对读。具体词源、将领名言与历史口号未核，先保拟音，不把整串硬译成一段史实。

notes.lemma: lipsyg dooley krieging the funk from the hinnessy... hinndoo Shimar Shin
notes.text: lipsyg、dooley、hinnessy、Shimar Shin、seeboy 让战事、人名与异语声串交织。杜利／亨尼西人物组与 sepoy 的读法可作候选，尚不据此固定全部角色。

notes.lemma: How Copenhagen ended. This way the museyroom. Mind your boots goan out.
notes.text: Copenhagen ended 与前文变形马名及结尾出馆指令相接。Mind your boots goan out 回应入馆时 Mind your hats goan in；这一首尾照应可直接从本段核到，不必补马匹葬礼史。

segments.original: Phew! What a warm time we were in there but how keling is here the airabouts! We nowhere she lives but you mussna tell annaone for the lamp of Jig-a-Lanthern! It's a candlelittle houthse of a month and one windies. Downadown, High Downadown. And nummered quaintlymine. And such reasonable weather too! The wagrant wind's awalt'zaround the piltdowns and on every blasted knollyrock (if you can spot fifty I spy four more) there's that gnarlybird ygathering, a runalittle, doalittle, preealittle, pouralittle, wipealittle, kicksalittle, severalittle, eatalittle, whinealittle, kenalittle, helfalittle, pelfalittle gnarlybird. A verytableland of bleakbardfields! Under his seven wrothschields lies one, Lumproar. His glav toside him. Skud ontorsed. Our pigeons pair are flewn for northcliffs. The three of crows have flapped it southenly, kraaking of de baccle to the kvarters of that sky whence triboos answer; Wail, 'tis well! She niver comes out when Thon's on shower or when Thon's flash with his Nixy girls or when Thon's blowing toomcracks down the gaels of Thon. No nubo no! Neblas on you liv! Her would be too moochy afreet. Of Burymeleg and Bindmerollingeyes and all the deed in the woe. Fe fo fom! She jist does hopes till byes will be byes. Here, and it goes on to appear now, she comes, a peacefugle, a parody's bird, a peri potmother, a pringlpik in the ilandiskippy, with peewee and powwows in beggybaggy on her bickybacky and a flick flask fleckflinging its pixylighting pacts' huemeramybows, picking here, pecking there, pussypussy plunderpussy. But it's the armitides toonigh, militopucos, and toomourn we wish for a muddy kissmans to the minutia workers and there's to be a gorgeups truce for happinest childher everwere. Come nebo me and suso sing the day we sallybright. She's burrowed the coacher's headlight the better to pry (who goes cute goes siocur and shoos aroun) and all spoiled goods go into her nabsack: curtrages and rattlin buttins, nappy spattees and flasks of all nations, clavicures and scampulars, maps, keys and woodpiles of haypennies and moonled brooches with bloodstaned breeks in em, boaston nightgarters and masses of shoesets and nickelly nacks and foder allmicheal and a lugly parson of cates and howitzer muchears and midgers and maggets, ills and ells with loffs of toffs and pleures of bells and the last sigh that come fro the hart (bucklied!) and the fairest sin the sunsaw (that's cearc!). With Kiss. Kiss Criss. Cross Criss. Kiss Cross. Undo lives 'end. Slain. How bootifull and how truetowife of her, when strengly forebidden, to steal our historic presents from the past postpropheticals so as to will make us all lordy heirs and ladymaidesses of a pretty nice kettle of fruit. She is livving in our midst of debt and laffing through all plores for us (her birth is uncontrollable), with a naperon for her mask and her sabboes kickin arias (so sair! so solly!) if yous ask me and I saack you. Hou! Hou! Gricks may rise and Troysirs fall (there being two sights for ever a picture) for in the byways of high improvidence that's what makes lifework leaving and the world's a cell for citters to cit in. Let young wimman run away with the story and let young min talk smooth behind the butteler's back. She knows her knight's duty while Luntum sleeps. Did ye save any tin? says he. Did I what? with a grin says she. And we all like a marriedann because she is mercenary. Though the length of the land lies under liquidation (floote!) and there's nare a hairbrow nor an eyebush on this glaubrous phace of Herrschuft Whatarwelter she'll loan a vesta and hire some peat and sarch the shores her cockles to heat and she'll do all a turfwoman can to piff the business on. Paff. To puff the blaziness on. Poffpoff. And even if Humpty shell fall frumpty times as awkward again in the beardsboosoloom of all our grand remonstrancers there'll be iggs for the brekkers come to mournhim, sunny side up with care. So true is it that therewhere's a turnover the tay is wet too and when you think you ketch sight of a hind make sure but you're cocked by a hin.
segments.draft: 嘿！方才馆内好一场闷热，步出馆外，此间周遭空气好生寒冽！吾辈自知彼居何处，惟凭南瓜提灯起誓，切莫告与旁人！彼乃仅容一烛之窄居，开窗三十有一扇。伏倒复伏倒，高高又伏倒。门牌奇异，二十有九。天色亦算合宜！浪荡长风旋舞掠过皮尔当丘岗，嶙峋碎石累累其上（君若辨得五十处，吾复探得四处），只见那只枯桠骨鸟正在啄拾：小跑一阵，弄巧一阵，窥探一阵，倾注一阵，抹拭一阵，踢蹬一阵，分拨一阵，啄食一阵，哀鸣一阵，端详一阵，援引一阵，搜刮一阵，好一只嶙峋骨鸟。实乃一片苍凉战场之高岗台地！七具赤盾之下，横卧隆然巨汉。宝剑在侧。身覆巨盾。吾双飞鸽已振翅直奔北方悬崖。三羽乌鸦向南奋翅，向四野诸部回应处哑声哀告大溃败；号哭罢，善哉！雷神倾盆泼雨，或偕水中双仙女闪现，或顺长风轰响雷霆之时，彼绝不出舍。绝无乌云，绝无！浓雾笼罩汝身，利维！彼必惊恐万状。惧怕埋足鬼与转眼妖，更惧世间诸般祸事亡灵。呼，吓，哼！彼惟寄望于来日方长。瞧，彼眼下现身，款款行来，好一只和睦领飞鸟，一只拟讽鸟，一位林泉仙母，一座跳岛雀峰，背负行囊，囊满小雀与议论，手中摇晃光壶，飞溅精灵微芒与虹霓盟约之斑斓色泽，此间拾掇，彼处啄汲，扑扑搜刮，无休无止。惟今夜乃休战长宵，小统帅临轩，明晨且祝微贱工徒泥浆圣诞，处处皆见天下快活孩童之美妙休战。且近吾侧，齐声同唱，欢庆此一光亮吉日。彼借得车夫前照头灯以利搜巡（机巧者走得稳妥，驱赶诸物四散），战后残秽尽入拾荒囊袋：残弹筒与当啷纽扣，尿布鞋罩与万国酒壶，锁钥骨殖与浪子肩章，舆图、门匙与积叠如柴之半便士，月光胸针嵌上染血马裤，波士顿夜袜吊带与成堆屐鞋，镀镍小什物与米迦勒节秣草，一盒丑陋婚饼与豪饮大耳杯，蚋蠓与蛆虫，千灾万厄伴豪客狂笑与钟声哀泣，自雄鹿心口溢出最后一声叹息（摧折也！），以及丽日照见最美原罪（此乃母鸡啄食！）。且以亲吻行礼。十字交吻。十字叉痕。十字吻别。寿数已尽。身死陨灭。严禁之下，彼竟盗出先知往事奉上历史馈赠，使得吾辈尽数承袭丰美禁果之残局，何其端秀，何其尽顺妇职！彼身寄利维河，活在吾辈累累欠债之中，穿透诸般涕泣为吾辈长笑（其降生狂放不羁），以围裙掩面为面具，踏木屐踢踏踏踢出咏叹调（何其痛伤！何其悲悯！），由君发问，任吾道来。吼！吼！希腊砖石可起，特洛伊裤褶可落（凡画皆有双重景界），皆因在荒诞挥霍歧途之上，此乃毕生劳作何以值得留存之故，而举世亦成一座囚牢，容市井庸民端坐其中。且听少妇携轶事私奔，任由少年在总管身后巧舌如簧。趁伦敦沉睡，彼深谙夜巡护卫之职。汝可积攒得半文现银？汉子问。吾何曾少攒分毫？妇人抿嘴笑道。吾辈皆喜已婚安娜，全因彼唯利是图。纵使全境遭逢大水清算（洪水滔滔！），在这位威灵顿公爵光秃秃面颊上寻不见一毫眉毛睫毛，彼仍会借来火柴，租来泥炭，沿岸搜巡烧热文蛤，尽泥炭妇人全副气力吹旺营生。扑。吹起烈烈火势。噗噗。纵令矮胖子蛋壳跌落，再在吾辈诸位谏官须髯胸怀间跌出七十个狼狈残局，亦有煎蛋端上守灵哀悼者早餐，单面煎透，轻拿轻放。诚然，馅饼翻面处茶水亦湿，正当君以为瞥见牝鹿后臀，切记留神，莫遭母鸡调戏戏弄。

notes.lemma: lamp of Jig-a-Lanthern... month and one windies... nummered quaintlymine
notes.text: month 与 one windies 可使人想到一月及窗数；quaintlymine 的具体数字读法未定。原文并没有直接写“三十一扇窗”或“门牌二十九”，中文不宜把猜数写死。

notes.lemma: wagrant wind's awalt'zaround the piltdowns... blasted knollyrock
notes.text: piltdowns 同时容纳地名 Piltdown 与低丘 downs 的声形。这里先保地景与史前联想；具体伪造案、发现年份及 Joyce 何时得知，未在本轮查证。

notes.lemma: gnarlybird ygathering, a runalittle, doalittle... pelfalittle
notes.text: 鸟与拾荒者的动作相互映照，runalittle 至 pelfalittle 连续反复。中文逐项保节奏。原交稿把它定为十二动作、十二陪审员，本轮未据原词数量与研究证实该对应。

notes.lemma: Under his seven wrothschields lies one, Lumproar. His glav toside him. Skud ontorsed.
notes.text: wrothschields 可联 red shields／Rothschild，Lumproar、glav、Skud ontorsed 也容许人名、剑盾与身体读法。家徽数量、人物身份和多语词源尚待核，不作确定历史说明。

notes.lemma: Our pigeons pair are flewn for northcliffs... three of crows... kraaking of de baccle
notes.text: 鸽子北飞、乌鸦南去构成方向对照。罗斯柴尔德传信致富故事若用于解释，须另核传说性质与本句联系；不能用故事本身替人物指认作证。

notes.lemma: she comes, a peacefugle, a parody's bird, a peri potmother, a pringlpik in the ilandiskippy
notes.text: peacefugle、parody's bird、peri、ilandiskippy 把和平、鸟鸣与仙灵声影缀在一起。可将拾荒鸟与母性角色并读；不把所有名词都还原成单一人物。

notes.lemma: flick flask fleckflinging its pixylighting pacts' huemeramybows... pussypussy plunderpussy
notes.text: huemeramybows 可联 hue、rainbow；pacts 又引出盟约之义。光、色与拾荒动作同在一句。与《创世记》彩虹之约的联系保留为项目读法，非已核作者自释。

notes.lemma: all spoiled goods go into her nabsack: curtrages... clavicures and scampulars... bloodstaned breeks
notes.text: nabsack 可叠听 knapsack 与 nab（攫取）。袋中清单混合衣物、器物和声形变体；不把每个陌生词都当成已辨认的战后实物，正文保留零碎杂物堆积之感。

notes.lemma: the fairest sin the sunsaw (that's cearc!). With Kiss. Kiss Criss. Cross Criss. Kiss Cross. Undo lives 'end. Slain.
notes.text: cearc 的爱尔兰语母鸡读法可作为线索，须补可靠词典。吻、十字和死亡用语在局部互相回响；不据这一处便断言每项都直接对应犹大之吻或具体受难仪式。

notes.lemma: steal our historic presents from the past postpropheticals... lordyheirs and ladymaidesses of a pretty nice kettle of fruit
notes.text: kettle of fruit 将惯用搭配 kettle of fish 改成水果，又与禁令、遗产及继承相连。可联禁果与原罪，但中文须保留债务、遗产的字面线索。

notes.lemma: She is livving in our midst of debt and laffing through all plores for us... with a naperon for her mask and her sabboes kickin arias
notes.text: in our midst of debt 把死亡祷文的声影转为负债；不是可直接标作《圣经》原句的引文。livving、plores 等可与生活、河流、哭笑并读，确切多语词源另查。

notes.lemma: Gricks may rise and Troysirs fall (there being two sights for ever a picture)... world's a cell for citters to cit in
notes.text: cell for citters to cit in 反复 c、t 音，让囚室与坐者互相缠绕。希腊／特洛伊声影和双重图像可并读；撤去本轮未核的麦克卢汉引用断言。

notes.lemma: do all a turfwoman can to piff the business on. Paff. To puff the blaziness on. Poffpoff.
notes.text: piff、paff、poff 连成吹火般声响，与泥炭妇和营生相接。是否直接改写名为 Push the Business On 的歌舞，本轮未查歌词，不写成已确认曲源。

notes.lemma: Humpty shell fall frumpty times... iggs for the brekkers come to mourn-him, sunny side up with care
notes.text: shellfall、breakfast 与 eggs 使跌碎的蛋和早餐相接，可联 Humpty Dumpty。seventy 与特定圣经惩罚数字的对应尚欠证，不拿猜测数字解释为唯一典故。

segments.original: Then as she is on her behaviourite job of quainance bandy, fruting for firstlings and taking her tithe, we may take our review of the two mounds to see nothing of the himples here as at elsewhere, by sixes and sevens, like so many heegills and collines, sitton aroont, scentbreeched and somepotreek, in their swishawish satins and their taffetaffe tights, playing Wharton's Folly, at a treepurty on the planko in the purk. Stand up, mickos! Make strake for minnas! By order, Nicholas Proud. We may see and hear nothing if we choose of the shortlegged bergins off Corkhill or the bergamoors of Arbourhill or the bergagambols of Summerhill or the bergincellies of Miseryhill or the countrybossed bergones of Constitutionhill though every crowd has its several tones and every trade has its clever mechanics and each harmonical has a point of its own, Olaf's on the rise and Ivor's on the lift and Sitric's place's between them. But all they are all there scraping along to sneeze out a likelihood that will solve and salve life's robulous rebus, hopping round his middle like kippers on a griddle, O, as he lays dormont from the macroborg of Holdhard to the microbirg of Pied de Poudre. Behove this sound of Irish sense. Really? Here English might be seen. Royally? One sovereign punned to petery pence. Regally? The silence speaks the scene. Fake! So This Is Dyoublong? Hush! Caution! Echoland! How charmingly exquisite! It reminds you of the outwashed engravure that we used to be blurring on the blotchwall of his innkempt house. Used they? (I am sure that tiring chabelshoveller with the mujikal chocolat box, Miry Mitchel, is listening) I say, the remains of the outworn gravemure where used to be blurried the Ptollmens of the Incabus. Used we? (He is only pretendant to be stugging at the jubalee harp from a second existed lishener, Fiery Farrelly.) It is well known. Lokk for himself and see the old butte new. Dbln. W. K. O. O. Hear? By the mausolime wall. Fimfim fimfim. With a grand funferall. Fumfum fumfum. 'Tis optophone which ontophanes. List! Wheatstone's magic lyer. They will be tuggling foriver. They will be lichening for allof. They will be pretumbling forover. The harpsdischord shall be theirs for ollaves. And here now they are, the fear of um. T. Totities! Unum. (Adar.) A bulbenboss surmounted upon an alderman. Ay, ay! Duum. (Nizam.) A shoe on a puir old wobban. Ah, ho! Triom. (Tamuz.) An auburn mayde, o'brine a'bride, to be desarted. Adear, adear! Quodlibus. (Marchessvan.) A penn no weightier nor a polepost. And so. And all. (Succoth.) notes.lemma: two mounds... himples... Wharton's Folly... Nicholas Proud
notes.text: mounds、himples、heegills、collines 让丘陵、身体与人群叠合。两座冢、Wharton's Folly 和 Nicholas Proud 的具体地理、身份与告示尚待核，暂不列未证地名对应。

notes.lemma: Corkhill... Arbourhill... Summerhill... Miseryhill... Constitutionhill
notes.text: 原文逐列 Corkhill、Arbourhill、Summerhill、Miseryhill、Constitutionhill，并给各群体不同声形。可读作城市复调；“五大名山”不是本轮核得的地理分类。

notes.lemma: Olaf's on the rise and Ivor's on the lift and Sitric's place's between them
notes.text: Olaf、Ivor、Sitric 是本句实际出现的名字，rise、lift、between them 带升降与位置关系。具体统治者、年代与“三位奠基者”之说未核，不把不同世代合为同一集团。

notes.lemma: macroborg of Holdhard to the microbirg of Pied de Poudre
notes.text: macroborg／microbirg 把大小、城堡、山体与躯体位置对置；Pied de Poudre 又可联尘足。具体法庭沿革与地图端点未核，中文先留宏观／微观转换。

notes.lemma: So This Is Dyoublong? Hush! Caution! Echoland!
notes.text: Dyoublong 可叠听 Dublin 与 do you belong；Echoland 则把地点写成回声之地。这里据词形提出声学读法，不把它宣布为全书唯一空间理论。

notes.lemma: outwashed engravure... blotchwall of his innkempt house... Ptollmens of the Incabus
notes.text: innkempt 可联 inn／unkempt；gravemure、Ptollmens、Incabus 容许墓墙、古物与梦魇的复合读法。壁画究竟描绘哪场会面、哪座王朝，本轮未核图像，不作定论。

notes.lemma: Miry Mitchel, is listening... Fiery Farrelly... old butte new
notes.text: Miry Mitchel、Fiery Farrelly 与听、琴、杂音同现。候选历史人物和偷听者身份尚未核，不直接等同John Mitchel或特定酒客。

notes.lemma: Dbln. W. K. O. O. Hear? By the mausolime wall. Fimfim fimfim. With a grand funferall. Fumfum fumfum
notes.text: Dbln. W. K. O. O. 像删去元音的地名与广播呼号，接着反复 Fimfim／Fumfum。可以保留广播与巨人儿歌的声响，不假称查到对应电台台号。

notes.lemma: 'Tis optophone which ontophanes. List! Wheatstone's magic lyer
notes.text: optophone、ontophanes、Wheatstone's magic lyer 让视觉、声音、显现与琴／谎言交织。仪器技术史、发明年份和具体装置须另核，本轮只采用原词可见的声形关系。

notes.lemma: tuggling foriver... lichening for allof... pretumbling forover... harpsdischord shall be theirs for ollaves
notes.text: ollaves 可联爱尔兰学者称谓，也可与 all of、always 并听。可靠词典、复数形式与本句适用义尚待补证；不直接据它宣称某两位国王仍在争斗。

notes.lemma: Mammon Lujius in his grand old historiorum, wrote near Boriorum, bluest book in baile's annals
notes.text: Mammon Lujius、herodotary、historiorum 把财神、史家与编年声影并置。与《四大师史》及具体编者的关系仍需原文或具名研究，暂不写成Joyce对某部国史的评价。

notes.lemma: Four things... bulbenboss... shoe on a puir old wobban... auburn mayde... penn no weightier nor a polepost
notes.text: Unum、Duum、Triom、Quodlibus 构成四项；括号又列 Adar、Nizam、Tamuz、Marchessvan、Succoth。月份、四省与人物配属尚未逐项核实；尤其不把 Nizam 静默改成 Nisan。

notes.lemma: innocens with anaclete play popeye antipop, the leaves of the living in the boke of the deeds, annals of themselves timing the cycles of events grand and national, bring fassilwise to pass how
notes.text: innocens／anaclete 可供教皇名读法；boke of the deeds 与 living 又让生者、功业和亡灵书互相照应。具体历史年份与作者使用路径未核，先保双关候选。

segments.original: 1132 a.d. Men like to ants or emmets wondern upon a groot hwide Whallfisk which lay in a Runnel. Blubby wares upat Ublanium. 566 a.d. On Baalfire's night of this year after deluge a crone that hadde a wickered Kish for to hale dead turves from the bog lookit under the blay of her Kish as she ran for to sothisfeige her cowrieosity and be me sawl but she found hersell sackvulle of swart goody quickenshoon and small illigant brogues, so rich in sweat. Blurry works at Hurdlesford. (Silent.) 566 a.d. At this time it fell out that a brazenlockt damsel grieved (sobralasolas!) because that Puppette her minion was ravisht of her by the ogre Puropeus Pious. Bloody wars in Ballyaughacleeaghbally. 1132 a.d. Two sons at an hour were born until a goodman and his hag. These sons called themselves Caddy and Primas. Primas was a santryman and drilled all decent people. Caddy went to Winehouse and wrote o peace a farce. Blotty words for Dublin.
segments.draft:
公元一一三二年。众人如蚁群聚，惊叹一条横卧溪渠之庞然巨鲸。都柏林之鲸脂商货。
公元五六六年。此年洪水退后之五朔篝火夜，老妪身负柳条泥炭筐自沼泽拖运干泥炭，奔跑间窥探筐盖之下以遂其好奇心，凭灵魂起誓，筐满黝黑山梨木粗履与小巧精致布洛克皮鞋，饱浸汗渍。津梁渡之混沌劳作。
（默。）
公元五六六年。此际恰逢铜发闺秀哀恸（波涛之上！），因其心爱玩偶遭虔敬欧罗巴食人魔掳掠。柴排城之血战。
公元一一三二年。良夫老妪同一时辰得生二子。二子自称卡迪与普利马斯。普利马斯官居桑特里哨兵，操练诸般体面良民。卡迪避入酒肆，写就一出和平闹剧。都柏林之斑斑墨迹。

notes.lemma: 1132 A.D. Men like to ants or emmets wondern upon a groot hwide Whallfisk... Blubby wares upat Ublanium
notes.text: 段内明列1132与566，后者恰为前者一半；鲸、商品与战争反复变形。原交稿所称1331年鲸鱼救荒、32郡与落体常数，未核对应史料和研究，暂撤定论。

notes.lemma: 566 A.D. On Baalfire's night... a crone that hadde a wickered Kish... Blurry works at Hurdlesford
notes.text: 老妪背筐、窥看、鞋履与汗水可从原句核到。sothisfeige 可供 Sothis 与 satisfy 的并读；确切词源、仪式和人物身份尚待考，不把候选神话写进动作事实。

notes.lemma: (Silent.) 566 A.D. At this time it fell out that a brazenlockt damsel grieved (sobralasolas!)... Bloody wars in Ballyaughacleeaghbally
notes.text: (Silent.) 打断编年条目；sobralasolas 可联歌名 Sobre las olas，Puppette 与 Puropeus Pious 容许玩偶、教皇与怪物的读法。是否直接借歌、角色对应何人，仍未核。

notes.lemma: 1132 A.D. Two sons at an hour were born until a goodman and his hag... Caddy and Primas... Blotty words for Dublin
notes.text: Primas 操练人群，Caddy 去酒馆写闹剧，行动对照清楚。可联双子、权力与写作；原文未明说出生先后，也不能据此直接宣告阿里斯托芬曲源或全书救赎主旨。

segments.original: Somewhere, parently, in the ginnandgo gap between antediluvious and annadominant the copyist must have fled with his scroll. The billy flood rose or an elk charged him or the sultrup worldwright from the excelsissimost empyrean (bolt, in sum) earthspake or the Dannamen gallous banged pan the bliddy duran. A scribicide then and there is led off under old's code with some fine covered by six marks or ninepins in metalmen for the sake of his labour's dross while it will be only now and again in our rear of o'er era, as an upshoot of military and civil engagements, that a gynecure was let on to the scuffold for taking that same fine sum covertly by meddlement with the drawers of his neighbour's safe.
segments.draft: 显见得，在洪荒史前与安娜主宰主后纪年之间的金伦加鸿沟某处，抄经僧定已携其羊皮手卷潜逃。或是浩浩大水暴涨，或有大角巨鹿迎面冲撞，或至高九重天那炎威难测之造物主（总之一声霹雳）降下地动，抑或丹麦凶悍盗匪猛擂血渍大门。杀戮抄书官者依照古法立时押赴偿款，不过交出六马克铜钱或几个金属九柱戏子，抵偿彼劳力残渣；反观吾辈纪元晚近，作为兵戎与民政纠纷之余波，贪图闲职之好色徒竟因暗中撬弄邻人保险箱抽屉，侵吞同等巨款，反倒送上断头台。

notes.text: scribicide、old's code、six marks、metalmen 使杀人、书写、法条与货币交叠。本轮未核布雷洪法具体条文、价额或铜人航标，撤去确定法制史说明。

notes.text: gynecure 可联 sinecure 与妇科语素；drawers 同时可指抽屉与内裤，scuffold 近 scaffold。古今惩罚失衡与窥私语义可并读，不必先固定全书罪案。

segments.original: Now after all that farfatch'd and peragrine or dingnant or clere lift we our ears, eyes of the darkness, from the tome of Liber Lividus and, (toh!), how paisibly eirenical, all dimmering dunes and gloamering glades, selfstretches afore us our fredeland's plain! Lean neath stone pine the pastor lies with his crook; young pricket by pricket's sister nibbleth on returned viridities; amaid her rocking grasses the herb trinity shams lowliness; skyup is of evergrey. Thus, too, for donkey's years. Since the bouts of Hebear and Hairyman the cornflowers have been staying at Ballymun, the duskrose has choosed out Goatstown's hedges, twolips have pressed togatherthem by sweet Rush, townland of twinedlights, the whitethorn and the redthorn have fairygeyed the mayvalleys of Knockmaroon, and, though for rings round them, during a chiliad of perihelygangs, the Formoreans have brittled the tooath of the Danes and the Oxman has been pestered by the Firebugs and the Joynts have thrown up jerrybuilding to the Kevanses and Little on the Green is childsfather to the City (Year! Year! And laughtears!), these paxsealing buttonholes have quadrilled across the centuries and whiff now whafft to us, fresh and made-of-all-smiles as, on the eve of Killallwho.
segments.draft: 且在领略这般牵强附会、游隼流浪、义愤填膺与清澈澄明之后，吾辈暗夜之眼，自《铅灰之书》宏卷抬起双耳，（啐！），看那微光沙丘与暮色幽林，何其宁谧和睦，自由之邦辽阔原野展布眼前！石松之下，牧人倚杖横卧；少鹿偕同小鹿胞妹，啃食返青芳草；在摇曳长草间，三位一体三叶草掩饰其低微；苍穹恒常一片青灰。漫漫岁月，向来如此。自埃贝尔与埃雷蒙争锋相斗以来，矢车菊长守巴利蒙，暮色玫瑰落户山羊镇树篱，郁金香双唇紧抿相印于甘美拉什微光交织之乡土，白刺花与红刺花点染诺克马伦五月仙谷；纵令周遭千载公转岁月里，弗摩尔巨妖挫碎丹麦之齿，东来维京商民频遭火虫骚扰，巨汉后人与圣凯文门徒胡乱建起豆腐渣屋宇，绿茵街小法院更是全城祖宗父母（悠悠岁月！兼带悲喜交加之涕泪！），此等缔结和平之胸花结，早已跨越千百年翩翩起舞，此刻向吾辈拂送阵阵馨香，鲜丽明媚如昔，恍若决战屠戳日前夕。

segments.original: The babbelers with their thangas vain have been (confusium hold them!) they were and went; thigging thugs were and houhnhymn songtoms were and comely norgels were and pollyfool fiansees. Menn have thawed, clerks have surssurhummed, the blond has sought of the brune: Elsekiss thou may, mean Kerry piggy?: and the duncledames have countered with the hellish fellows: Who ails tongue coddeau, aspace of dumbillsilly? And they fell upong one another: and themselves they have fallen. And still nowanights and by nights of yore do all bold floras of the field to their shyfaun lovers say only: Cull me ere I wilt to thee!: and, but a little later: Pluck me whilst I blush! Well may they wilt, marry, and profusedly blush, be troth! For that saying is as old as the howitts. Lave a whale a while in a whillbarrow (isn't it the truath I'm tallin ye?) to have fins and flippers that shimmy and shake. Tim Timmycan timped hir, tampting Tam. Fleppety! Flippety! Fleapow! Hop!
segments.draft: 多舌妄言之徒怀揣虚妄之思，曾几何时（叫混乱紧缚彼等！），来而复往；行乞暴徒曾在此，慧骃唱诗汉曾在此，娇美北欧闺秀曾在此，痴心愚顽情侣亦曾在此。众人消融，文书低语沉吟，金发客向褐发女索爱：‘汝可吻吾，吾之凯里小娇娘？’；幽暗贵妇则反诘地狱恶汉：‘汝之聘礼何在，糊涂蠢才？’。彼等相互扑跌：自身亦随之堕落。无论今宵还是往昔长夜，原野上诸般泼辣花神，只向羞赧牧神情郎娇声催促：‘采吾于凋萎之前！’；稍顷又道：‘折吾当双颊绯红之际！’。彼等大可凋萎，委身成婚，纵情脸红，信然不假！皆因这般言语亘古如霍斯丘岗。且教巨鲸在独轮手推车里暂留片刻（吾所言岂非千真万确？），好教鳍足摆荡轻颤。提姆罐头诱惑彼女，试探汤姆。扑腾！飞跃！扑哧！跃！

notes.text: 两段问答带求爱与索礼语气，可供丹麦语／法语近音读法。本轮未核旧注列出的整句原语，撤去“源自某句”的强断言；正文只保对话动作与未定人称。

notes.text: cull me／clip me、wilt／blush 把采花、凋萎、脸红与求爱并置，可联及时行乐传统。未核具体诗篇，不标成某首诗的直接引文。

notes.lemma: Lave a whale a while in a whillbarrow... Tim Timmycan timped hir, tampting Tam. Fleppety! Flippety! Fleapow! Hop!
notes.text: 推车、鲸与末尾连续拟声由大物转到跳动的小动作。Fleapow 可联 flea powder；歌谣名称、人物身份及镜头跃迁理论仍是候选，不充当事实。

segments.original: In the name of Anem this carl on the kopje in pelted thongs a parth a lone who the joebiggar be he? Forshapen his pigmaid hoagshead, shroonk his plodsfoot. He hath locktoes, this shortshins, and, Obeold that's pectoral, his mammamuscles most mousterious. It is slaking nuncheon out of some thing's brain pan. Me seemeth a dragon man. He is almonthst on the kiep fief by here, is Comestipple Sacksoun, be it junipery or febrewery, marracks or alebrill or the ramping riots of pouriose and froriose. What a quhare soort of a mahan. It is evident the michindaddy. Lets we overstep his fire defences and these kraals of slitsucked marrogbones. (Cave!) He can prapsposterus the pillory way to Hirculos pillar. Come on, fool porterfull, hosiered women blown monk sewer? Scuse us, chorley guy! You tollerday donsk? N. You tolkatiff scowegian? Nn. You spigotty anglease? Nnn. You phonio saxo? Nnnn. Clear all so! 'Tis a Jute. Let us swop hats and excheck a few strong verbs weak oach eather yapyazzard abast the blooty creeks.
segments.draft: 凭万名之尊起誓，这名身披兽皮绑带、孤居小丘之粗汉，究竟是何方乞丐老乔？粗野畸形如侏儒大猪头，重足蜷缩。这短腿汉双趾紧扣，瞧那胸膛，胸肌如凶兽暴突。彼正捧着不知何物之头盖骨，畅饮正午羹汤。依吾看来真如龙人。彼终年在此据守封邑，正是萨克森巡警，任凭杜松一月、酒坊二月、兵营三月、麦酒四月，或是暴雨月与霜冻月之狂乱喧嚣。好一个稀奇古怪之汉子。显然正是土著老祖。且教吾辈跨过其防火藩篱与这圈劈开吸髓之骨殖堆。（当心洞穴！）彼大可颠三倒四，自耻辱柱一路直奔大力神石柱。上前去，斟满麦酒试言欢，先生可敢妄责吾辈？抱歉，查理老哥！汝讲丹麦话否？不。汝通挪威言语？否。汝通晓英语？非。汝可解盎格鲁撒克逊古调？绝不。昭然若揭！此乃朱特人。且教吾辈互换冠帽，在这血色溪流畔，胡乱以强动词同弱动词交锋几招。

notes.text: 原文 brain pan、nuncheon、dragon man、michindaddy 把头颅、食器、午食与祖先声影并置。中文保怪诞形体；michindaddy 不截成 indaddy 再据截词造词源。

notes.text: junipery、febrewery、marracks、alebrill 可听出月份、杜松、酒坊、军营与麦酒。pouriose／froriose 可联共和历月名；确切语源仍须查词典，不据近音补历史。

segments.original:
Jute.— Yutah!

Mutt.— Mukk's pleasurad.

Jute.— Are you jeff?

Mutt.— Somehards.

Jute.— But you are not jeffmute?

Mutt.— Noho. Only an utterer.

Jute.— Whoa? Whoat is the mutter with you?

Mutt.— I became a stun a stummer.

Jute.— What a hauhauhauhaudibble thing, to be cause! How, Mutt?

Mutt.— Aput the buttle, surd.

Jute.— Whose poddle? Wherein?

Mutt.— The Inns of Dungtarf where Used awe to be he.

Jute.— You that side your voise are almost inedible to me. Become a bitskin more wiseable, as if I were you.

Mutt.— Has? Has at? Hasatency? Urp, Boohooru! Booru Usurp! I trumple from rath in mine mines when I rimimirim!

Jute.— One eyegonblack. Bisons is bisons. Let me fore all your hasitancy cross your qualm with trink gilt. Here have sylvan coyne, a piece of oak. Ghinees hies good for you.

Mutt.— Louee, louee! How wooden I not know it, the intellible greytcloak of Cedric Silkyshag! Cead mealy faulty rices for one dabblin bar. Old grilsy growlsy! He was poached on in that eggtentical spot. Here where the liveries, Monomark. There where the missers moony, Minnikin passe.

Jute.— Simply because as Taciturn pretells, our wrongstoryshortener, he dumptied the wholeborrow of rubbages on to soil here.

Mutt.— Just how a puddinstone inat the brookcells by a riverpool.

Jute.— Load Allmarshy! Wid wad for a norse like?

Mutt.— Somular with a bull on a clompturf. Rooks roarum rex roome! I could snore to him of the spumy horn, with his woolseley side in, by the neck I am sutton on, did Brian d' of Linn.

Jute.— Boildoyle and rawhoney on me when I can beuraly forsstand a weird from sturk to finnic in such a patwhat as your rutterdamrotter. Onheard of and umscene! Gut aftermeal! See you doomed.

Mutt.— Quite agreem. Bussave a sec. Walk a dun blink roundward this albutisle and you skull see how olde ye plaine of my Elters, hunfree and ours, where wone to wail whimbrel to peewee o'er the saltings, where wilby citie by law of isthmon, where by a droit of signory, icefloe was from his Inn the Byggning to whose Finishthere Punct. Let erehim ruhmuhrmuhr. Mearmerge two races, swete and brack. Morthering rue. Hither, craching eastuards, they are in surgence: hence, cool at ebb, they requiesce. Countlessness of livestories have netherfallen by this plage, flick as flowflakes, litters from aloft, like a waast wizzard all of whirlworlds. Now are all tombed to the mound, isges to isges, erde from erde. Pride, O pride, thy prize!

Jute.— 'Stench!

Mutt.— Fiatfuit! Hereinunder lyethey. Llarge by the smal an' everynight life olso th'estrange, babylone the great-grandhotelled with tit tit tittlehouse, alp on earwig, drukn on ild, likeas equal to anequal in this sound seemetery which iz leebez luv.

Jute.— 'Zmorde!

Mutt.— Meldundleize! By the fearse wave behoughted. Despond's sung. And thanacestross mound have swollup them all. This ourth of years is not save brickdust and being humus the same returns. He who runes may rede it on all fours. O'c'stle, n'wc'stle, tr'c'stle, crumbling! Sell me sooth the fare for Humblin! Humblady Fair. But speak it allsosiftly, moulder! Be in your whisht!

Jute.— Whysht?

Mutt.— The gyant Forficules with Amni the fay.

Jute.— Howe?

Mutt.— Here is viceking's graab.

Jute.— Hwaad!

Mutt.— Ore you astoneaged, jute you?

Jute.— Oye am thonthorstrok, thing mud.
segments.draft:
朱特：——幸会！
穆特：——泥巴深感荣幸。
朱特：——汝耳聋否？
穆特：——稍许背晦。
朱特：——总不至成聋哑人？
穆特：——非也。惟管吐词发声。
朱特：——何故？汝究竟惹何麻烦？
穆特：——吾化为顽石，口齿结巴。
朱特：——何其哈哈可笑而可怖之怪事！何以至此，穆特？
穆特：——皆因那场鏖战，大人。
朱特：——何人鏖战？在何处？
穆特：——克朗塔夫泥泞野店，昔年彼横行之地。
朱特：——汝那般喉音，吾几乎难以下咽。何不稍显明智，犹如吾辈设身处地？
穆特：——犹豫？犹疑？‘犹疑’错字？呃，布赖恩·博鲁！博鲁篡权！每逢追忆及彼，吾脑际怒火翻腾，浑身战栗！
朱特：——黑了一只乌眼。公事自当公办。且教吾赶在汝满心犹疑之际，以闪亮赏金平伏汝之悸动。此间奉上林间木币，一块橡木。几枚金镑对汝自是大有裨益。
穆特：——哎呀，哎呀！吾岂能不识此物，正是西特里克丝须海王那件洗不褪色之灰斗篷！奉上十万次欢迎劣米，换取一回都柏林盘剥。老迈暴躁之骨殖！正是在那军帐原处遭人暗算偷袭。此处正是制服标识，独门印记。彼处正是遗失月色，小碎步穿过。
朱特：——全因恰如沉默史官预言，替吾辈洗冤省事者，在此处泥土倾倒整整一手推车生活垃圾。
穆特：——正如溪涧水塘深处之卵石砾岩。
朱特：——全能至尊！可似奔马？
穆特：——颇似泥沼中一头公牛。角鸣震天，君临天下！吾大可向彼鼾声吹嘘翻穿羊毛之泡沫长角，依其颈项吾敢笃定，正是林恩之布赖恩。
朱特：——滚油伴生蜜淋吾头脸，在汝这摊鹿特丹烂泥里，吾勉强难通一词，自始至终不知所云。闻所未闻，粗鄙下流！午餐安歇！休怪遭天谴。

穆特：——甚为赞同。且慢行片刻。回眸打量此座几乎成岛之半岛，汝当看清吾辈先祖之原野，自由亦属吾辈，杓鹬偕同麦鸡在盐沼哀鸣，如何依凭地峡之法筑成城邑，复依领主特权，浮冰自客栈开辟之初漂至终局定点。任由彼等低沉私语。淡水与咸水交汇，两族大融合。悔恨噬心。向东汹涌撞击，巨浪翻腾；向西退潮冷却，诸灵安歇。万千鲜活生命故事坠落海滩，如雪花飘落，如天降落叶，似大荒原上旋转大千世界。如今皆归葬古冢，灰归于灰，土归于土。骄矜，噢骄矜，此乃汝之报应！
朱特：——恶臭！
穆特：——曾有之，今已逝！彼等尽卧其下。宏伟伴微末，日常伴奇诡，巴比伦巍峨大饭店伴山雀微舍，高山依伴丘峦，平等伴不平，尽皆安卧于这处静默墓园，此乃爱之爱。
朱特：——上帝之死！
穆特：——温和轻柔！汹涌狂涛亦渐平复。绝望之歌已唱罢。死亡巨冢吞噬万物。千百载尘世不过是砖灰瓦砾，化为泥土后周而复始。识符文者四足爬行自能辨读。老堡、新堡、都柏林，尽皆坍塌！直言告吾奔赴卑微都柏林之船资！哈！血染集市。且低声细语，入土亡魂！噤声切莫言！
朱特：——为何噤声？
穆特：——蠼螋巨怪偕同仙女安娜。
朱特：——何处？
穆特：——此地正是副王古冢。
朱特：——何物！
穆特：——汝可如坠石器时代惊骇莫名，顽石朱特？
朱特：——吾遭雷霆击顶，同化泥土。
segments.translation:
朱特：——哟嗒！

穆特：——穆克深感荣幸。

朱特：——你耳聋么？

穆特：——有点背晦。

朱特：——可你不是聋哑人？

穆特：——不哟。只是个吐词人。

朱特：——谁？什么？你咕哝什么？

穆特：——我成了石，成了个结、结巴。

朱特：——这可真哈哈哈可怕！怎么回事，穆特？

穆特：——那场鏖战，大人。

朱特：——谁家水坑？在哪儿？

穆特：——邓塔夫泥粪客栈，昔年那位所在之地。

朱特：——你那边的嗓音，我简直吞不下。换张薄皮，清楚些；换作我就这样。

穆特：——犹？犹疑？犹误字？呃，布呼博鲁！博鲁篡权！一想起，我就怒得、怕得发抖！

朱特：——一只乌黑眼。野牛归野牛，往事归往事。趁你犹疑，让我拿点金闪酒意安你的心。来，林间钱，一块橡木。金几尼对你好。

穆特：——路易，路易！我怎会不认得，塞德里克·丝毛客那可辨又灰伟的斗篷！万欢迎、万劣米，换一根达布林酒吧棍。老灰毛，老咆哮！他就在那个一模一样的蛋帐地方遭了暗算。此处制服，独门标记。彼处月色小姐，碎步而过。

朱特：——只因如沉默史家预言，我们的错史缩短者把整车废物都倾倒在这片土上。

穆特：——恰似溪胞河潭里的布丁石。

朱特：——全能沼泽啊！像匹北马么？

穆特：——像泥沼上的公牛。群鸦吼，王室鸣！我能向他鼾讲那泡沫号角；羊毛面翻在里头，我正坐在那脖颈上，像林恩的布赖恩那般。

朱特：——煮油生蜜泼我身吧！你这鹿特丹烂话，从头到芬尾，我几乎听不懂一个字。这叫什么混话！闻所未闻、未曾看见！午后好胃口！回头见你遭殃。

穆特：——很赞同。再等一息。绕这近乎岛屿处眨眼看一回，你会看见先祖原野有多古老，自由而属于我们；往昔杓鹬和麦鸡在盐沼哀鸣，地峡之法将成一城，领主之权使冰流从他家建始漂到那终点。让他喃喃喃。两族混融，淡与咸。母般悔恨。此处向东涌撞；彼处退潮凉歇。无数生命故事落在这岸边，如流沫飞雪，如空中落叶，像旋风巫师卷着重重世界。如今尽埋丘冢，灰归灰，土归土。骄傲，噢骄傲，这就是你的奖赏！

朱特：——臭啊！

穆特：——要有，曾有！都卧在下面了。大与小，每夜生活与陌异，伟大巴比伦旅店与山雀小屋，高山覆着耳夹虫，老中醉着；相等也不相等，就在这声响墓园，爱之爱。

朱特：——天死啦！

穆特：——温和轻柔！凶浪思念着。绝望之歌。祖死之冢吞下了一切。多年尘世不过砖灰，化作腐土仍回转。读符文者可四足爬行辨它。老堡、新堡、第三堡，坍塌！老实告诉我，到卑微都柏林的路费！卑血集市。不过轻轻说，腐土人！嘘，小声！

朱特：——小声为何？

穆特：——蠼螋巨人与仙女阿姆尼。

朱特：——如何？

穆特：——这儿就是副王维京王的墓。

朱特：——什么！

穆特：——你石器惊呆了么，朱特？

朱特：——我雷得发懵啦，泥家伙。

notes.lemma: Yutah!... Mukk's pleasurad. Are you jeff?... jeffmute?... Only an utterer... stun a stummer
notes.text: Mutt／Jute 与 Jeff、mute、deaf、utterer 等声影构成沟通笑料，可联漫画 Mutt and Jeff。stun／stummer 也让石化与口吃相遇；不是确定人物国籍的证据。

notes.lemma: The Inns of Dungtarf where Used awe to be he... Hasatency? Urp, Boohooru! Booru Usurp!
notes.text: Dungtarf 可联 Clontarf，Hasatency 可联帕奈尔案误拼故事。战役及伪信史实须另核原件与具名研究；此处先保战争、篡位、追忆与犹疑的局部语义。

notes.lemma: Cedric Silkyshag! Cead mealy faulty rices for one dabblin bar. Old grilsy grout! He was poached on in that eggtentical spot
notes.text: Cedric Silkyshag 可联丝须王；Cead mealy faulty rices 可供爱尔兰欢迎语读法。原交稿把不同王者与遇刺故事合叙，本轮撤去确定身份，保声音线索待考。

notes.lemma: Taciturn pretells... dumptied the wholeborrow of rubbages on to soil here... puddinstone... Brian d' of Linn... Boildoyle and rawhoney
notes.text: wholeborrow／rubbages 把手推车与废料叠合，puddinstone 又落到地质物。Boildoyle／rawhoney 容许地名与滚油生蜜双读；Gut aftermeal／See you doomed 把告别说成恶咒。

notes.lemma: Walk a dun blink roundward this albutisle and you skull see how ye plaine of my Elters... Mearmerge two races, swete and brack... isges to isges, erde from erde
notes.text: albutisle 可听成 all-but-isle；swete／brack、surgence／ebb 让淡咸两水与人群聚散并读。灰归灰、土归土构成悼亡节拍，不把全部地名和族群配属当作已证。

notes.lemma: Fiatfuit! Hereinunder lyethey. Llarge by the smal... sound seemetery which iz leebez luv
notes.text: 见证原词为 sound seemetery，非旧稿 stumseemetery。它让声音与墓园并置；巨大旅馆、小屋、earwig 与相等／不等同场。与瓦格纳具体乐段关系另查。

notes.lemma: 'Zmorde!... Meldundleize! By the fearse wave behoughted. Despond's sung. And thanacestross mound have swollup them all. This ourth of years is not save brickdust and being humus the same roturns
notes.text: Meldundleize 可近听 Mild und leise，Despond's sung 又有绝望、泥淖与歌声。瓦格纳曲源仍须核曲文；本轮不把它写成已经查过的整段引用。

notes.lemma: He who runes may rede it on all fours. O'c'stle, n'wc'stle, trublin, crumbling!... viceking's graab... Ore you astoneaged, jute you? / Oye am thonthorstrok, thing mud
notes.text: viceking's graab 叠听副王、维京王与墓穴；astoneaged、thonthorstrok、thing mud 让惊骇、石器、雷击与泥土相接。末句是否指人物真的碎裂，原文未明说。

segments.draft: （俯身吧，）你若满心念着字母，且向这部泥板书俯下身来（劳驾俯身），瞧瞧大地字母表间藏着何等奇绝符印！你能否辨读其间乾坤（既然你我早有分晓）？这故事放之四海而皆准。千人千面。杂交复杂交。称量有据。他们生过、笑过、爱过，终归离去。罪衍已定。你的国度早归米底与波斯。此乃蜿蜒旧闻，失而复得，记述白云覆顶的巨人行步人间之岁月中，我们那座老异教堡之沧桑。缘于无明，萌生心行；心行编织神识，神识勘定名色；名色磨砺诸根，诸根转输触受；触受泛起甘甜，甘甜驱策渴爱；渴爱胶着执取，执取催逼死灭；死灭纠缠受生，受生拖带业报流转。然而从他肚脐奔涌而出一道洪流，直抵拉玛之殿后壁。好一幅泥土生灵活景；诡奇，且至今颤栗不休。一把石斧，一块石凿，一片犁铧，用意无非昼夜破拆地壳，或顺犁沟，或逆犁沟，犹如回转道上之并轭耕牛。且看好战泥俑披甲跨骑。跨骑披甲的好战泥俑正在眼前。按卢恩之序，此尊细小人俑乃掌火之手，唤作坠石火镰。朝东看齐！哎呀我服！朝腰看齐！嗬，休叫！抡起猛摔，正面撞反面！当微小局部代行整体之职，我们旋即习惯借片语辨读全貌。此处（还请俯身）散落几撮排队小豌豆，颇具铜臭趣味，因它们正是填饱肚皮的饷金丸粒。诸神黄昏巨岩巍然列阵，红毛猩猩曾执乱石粗暴撕打，横冲直撞。哎呀，哎呀，何苦来哉？硬刺深扎泥土，宛如蠢货叛徒复仇之刺。这番局面搅得好生狼藉！一座贝冢密藏杂物堆！橄榄、甜菜、扁豆、玩偶，尽是阿弗雷德、比蒂、科马克与道尔顿遗存。此处有猫头鹰蛋（啊，赏脸俯身吧！），年代久远干裂，皆化虚无微尘；更有老派晃荡客，轻如一抹草屑。嘶！四下皆见蛇虫蜿蜒！我们都柏林城蛇虫成群。它们远自潮湿草甸外三角地渡海而来，藏身禁果禁运货箱；幸而挥鞭帕迪登岸，执垃圾桶收拢蛇蝎爬虫，其迅捷远胜家中长舌妇卷收裙衫。有人瓜分，有人通吞，账目结清，总归同一笔糊涂烂账。尽是敲诈客与私酒贩。

notes.text: abcedminded 让字母表与 absentminded 相叠，claybook 把泥土写成书。Many、Tieckle、Forsin、Meades and Porsons 可联《但以理书》墙上文字，具体引文与译名仍须逐词核对。

segments.draft: 斧劈斧斫，斧风呼啸，势如伐木。一个个按位排布，排成同列三个，前置其一。二养其一，凑成似模似样三个，后落其一。起初是一条大蟒、几头三脚牛犊，外加嘴衔口信的斑驳驽马。更有百乘无酵沉重的人类子嗣长列，任我们穷尽目力辨认，直至万圣鬼节前夕。好一部蜿蜒铺展的尼安德特巨篇，终局只见蹲踞者、反蹲踞者与反抗先祖的蹲踞者！且向我们挑明：我们当中的每一个蒂姆、尼克与拉里，泥土之子，子子孙孙，乃至重重玄孙；在我们化为乌有时，每一个苏、茜茜与萨莉，南的女儿们！被告席上的始祖！该死的亚当绵延无绝！想当年，荒野中尚无纸张碎屑，巍峨笔峰仍在阵痛，迟迟未能诞下一只小鼠。一切尽属远古。你踹我一靴（有痕为证！），我喝尽西北风。我盘问你一文（为了何故？），你便身陷牢狱。然而要明白，天地人间，凡属我们理性下感官触及之万象，世界恒久都在其上自刻卢恩铭文，直到最后一头奶驼眉心心脉狂跳，停驻于堂妹幽坟之前，驼绳拴缚于伊人棕榈树下。不过角号、狂饮、惊怖之日尚未降临。一截骨，一枚石，一张羊皮；凿平它们，斩切它们，随手裁切；任其在低语锅中泥炉煨烤。古腾堡携克罗马农大宪章，以坚固铅字与大号初阶，必为大众自印字机间迈出殷红一笔，否则古兰宝卷便再无神力。全因（通灵者告诫）纸张正是由此做成，由皮毛、隐语与印漏之词合成。直至诸位终于（尚不算终了）结识活字先生、托普太太与一众小活字。句点填满。因此无须你向我拼读：在这部两端相合之书中，字字句句皆须承载七十重绝妙解说（谁若拆解此书，愿污泥抹黑其额！），直到大门字母达勒特开启它，亦关闭其门。先莫啼哭！尚未到头，仍有欢笑，每位绅士配六十侍女，烛火映照下公园一片晦暗。且看你手握何物！活字正在游走、列队前行，全在行进，步步紧凑，曲折向前；每位忙碌诡奇的辉格党人，皆有几分托利党故事可叙。其一踞于百里香，其二潜于莴苣叶，其三隐于草莓畦。小鸡剔牙，蠢驴开腔。你可问问自家毛驴信是不信。如此拥抱我吧，唯有痛打留得脚后跟。那位戴四十顶假发的发妻。皆因当年正是裙撑高耸年代。记述一位族长与利嘴悍妇；记述一枚沉重苹果与轻佻妇人；记述待阉割的金发少年；记述恶作剧少女逼人犯险。怨偶结缡，他遭她荒唐闹剧与曼妙战舞折腾得气绝倒戈。凭信起誓，这蛇样妇人当真放浪！自这灵动碎步，且看好戏！面纱轻掩，飞扬传情的眼眸。她正如好风吹拂，向善意道不。水流进，安娜流淌。嗬嗬！可见罪责全在她身，绝非我等！且放平心绪，温厚君子，我们正抚育一只小地蜈蚣。如此纤小细碎。过来看！他若知晓定会明白。轻灵！轻灵！我正在做。听，号角声声相邀！竖琴琴韵叮咚。

It was of a night, late, lang time agone, in an auldstane eld, when Adam was delvin and his madameen spinning watersilts, when mulk mountynotty man was everybully and the first leal ribberrobber that ever had her ainway everybuddy to his lovesaking eyes and everybilly lived alove with everybiddy else, and Jarl van Hoother had his burnt head high up in his lamphouse, laying cold hands on himself. And his two little jiminies, cousins of ourn, Tristopher and Hilary, were kickaheeling their dummy on the oil cloth flure of his homerigh, castle and earthenhouse. And, be dermot, who come to the keep of his inn only the niece-of-his-in-law, the prankquean. And the prankquean pulled a rosy one and made her wit foreninst the dour. And she lit up and fireland was ablaze. And spoke she to the dour in her petty perusienne: Mark the Wans, why do I am alook alike a poss of porterpease? And that was how the skirtmisshes began. But the dour handworded her grace in dootch nossow: Shut! So her grace o'malice kidsnapped up the jiminy Tristopher and into the shandy westerness she rain, rain, rain. And Jarl van Hoother warlessed after her with soft dovesgall: Stop deef stop come back to my earin stop. But she swaradid to him: Unlikelihud. And there was a brannewail that same sabboath night of falling angles somewhere in Erio. And the prankquean went for her forty years' walk in Tourlemonde and she washed the blessings of the lovespots off the jiminy with soap sulliver suddles and she had her four owlers masters for to tauch him his tickles and she convorted him to the onesure allgood and he became a luderman. So then she started to rain and to rain and, be redtom, she was back again at Jarl van Hoother's in a brace of samers and the jiminy with her in her pinafrond, lace at night, at another time. And where did she come but to the bar of his bristolry. And Jarl von Hoother had his baretholobruised heels drowned in his cellarmalt, shaking warm hands with himself and the jimminy Hilary and the dummy in their first infancy were below on the tearsheet, wringing and coughing, like brodar and histher. And the prankquean nipped a paly one and lit up again and redcocks flew flackering from the hillcombs. And she made her witter before the wicked, saying: Mark the Twy, why do I am alook alike two poss of porterpease? And: Shut! says the wicked, handwording her madesty. So her madesty a forethought set down a jiminy and took up a jiminy and all the lilipath ways to Woeman's Land she rain, rain, rain. And Jarl von Hoother bleethered atter her with a loud finegale: Stop domb stop come back with my earring stop. But the prankquean swaradid: Am liking it. And there was a wild old grannewwail that laurency night of starshootings somewhere in Erio. And the prankquean went for her forty years' walk in Turnlemeem and she punched the curses of cromcruwell with the nail of a top into the jiminy and she had her four larksical monitrix to touch him his tears and she provorted him to the onecertain allsecure and he became a tristian. So then she started raining, raining, and in a pair of changers, be dom ter, she was back again at Jarl von Hoother's and the Larryhill with her under her abromette. And why would she halt at all if not by the ward

of his mansionhome of another nice lace for the third charm? And Jarl von Hoother had his hurricane hips up to his pantrybox, ruminating in his holdfour stomachs (Dare! O dare!), and the jiminy Toughertrees and the dummy were belove on the watercloth, kissing and spitting, and roguing and poghuing, like knavepaltry and naivebride and in their second infancy. And the prankquean picked a blank and lit out and the valleys lay twinkling. And she made her wittest in front of the arkway of trihump, asking: Mark the Tris, why do I am alook alike three poss of porter pease? But that was how the skirtmishes endupped. For like the campbells acoming with a fork lance of lightning, Jarl von Hoother Boanerges himself, the old terror of the dames, came hip hop handihap out through the pikeopened arkway of his three shuttoned castles, in his broadginger hat and his civic chollar and his allabuff hemmed and his bullbraggin soxangloves and his ladbroke breeks and his cattegut bandolair and his furframed panuncular cumbottes like a rudd yellan gruebleen orangeman in his violet indigonation, to the whole longth of the strongth of his bowman's bill. And he clopped his rude hand to his eacy hitch and he ordurd and his thick spch spck for her to shut up shop, dappy. And the duppy shot the shutter clup (Perkodhuskurunbarggruauyagokgorlayorgromgremmitghundhurthrumathunaradidillifaititillibumullunukkunun!) And they all drank free. For one man in his armour was a fat match always for any girls under shurts. And that was the first peace of illiterative porthery in all the flamend floody flatuous world. How kirssy the tiler made a sweet unclose to the Narwhealian captol. Saw fore shalt thou sea. Betoun ye and be.
